translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry ya fadi cewa zai “dawo Texas domin tantance sakamakon caucus na daren nan, in tantance ko akwai ko akwai alaman ci gaba man a wannan tsere”, amma daga baya ya ce zai ci gaba da tseren sannan ya yi gasan fid da gwani ran 21 ga Janairu a South Carolina.
translations.hypothesis: بيري صرح أنه "سيرجع إلى تكساس لتقييم نتائج ناخبين الليلة، وتحديد ما إذا كان هناك طريق للمضي قدمًا لي في هذه الانتخابات"، ولكنه لاحقًا قال أنه سيبقى في الانتخابات ويشارك في الانتخابات الرئيسية في ولاية ساوت كارولينا في 21 كانون الثاني.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bachmann, wanda ya lashe zaben Ames Straw Poll a watan Agusta, ya yanke shawarar kawo karshen kamfen din ta.
translations.hypothesis: باخمان، وadda za ta lashe zaɓen Ames Straw Poll a watan Agusta, ta yanke shawarinsa na kammala kampayensu.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: An mayar da mai daukan hoton zuwa asibitin Ronarld Reagan UCLA Medical Center, inda ya mutu.
translations.hypothesis: الفنان عكاسي وُضعتوه في مستشفى طبية لـ UCLA، حيث لاحقًا وُفي بعمره.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: An ruwaito cewa yana cikin shekaran sa na 20 ne. A cikin wata sanarwa, Bieber ya ce “duk da ya ke ba na wurin kuma ba ni da hannu kai tsaye cikin wannan mummunan hadarin, tunani da addu'o’ina suna tare da dangin waɗanda abin ya rutsa da su.”
translations.hypothesis: الروايات تظهر أنه كان في شيخوكي. في إيجاز, بيبر قال: "[حيث أنني لست موجودًا ولا شاركت بشكل مباشر في wannan abu, فكراتي و الصلوات نا مابايي لأسرة ضحية]."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Shagin yanar-gizo na labarun nishaɗi na TMZ ya fahimta cewa mai ɗaukar hoto ɗin ya tsayar da motsarsa a tsallaken titin Sepulveda Boulevard kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar hotuna na tsayawar ƴan sanda kafin ya tsallaka titin kuma ya ci gaba, wanda ya sa ɗan sanda na Sintirin Babbar Hanya ta California wanda yake ba da hannu ya umarce shi ya koma a ƙetare, sau biyu.
translations.hypothesis: موقع إخباري "TMZ" wanda ke tallafawa labarai da zaɓɓiya, ya san cewa ɗayan masu ɗauwa surausaya ya cika motinsa a karshen Bulwar Sepulveda, kuma ya yi kokarin ɗauwa surausaya na rundunar hukuma kafin ya wuce dinkin waya, wannan ya sa ofisarin rundunar hukuma na California Highway Patrol, wanda ke yi wa aikin jikewa, ya order shi ya koma baya, biyu da biyu.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Bisa ga fadin yan sanda, direban motan da ya buge mai hoton na iya fuskantan zargin aikata laifi.
translations.hypothesis: حسب الشرطة, قائدي سرج اللي اصطدم مع المصور, فكلي يواجه اتهامات криминальные.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Da lambobin yabo goma sha takwas kacal da ake da su a rana, kasashe da dama sun gaza kaiwa ga dandamalin bada lambar yabo.
translations.hypothesis: حيث لا توجد سوى 18 ميدالية متاح يوميًا، شتى أوطان لا يزالوا قادين.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Sun hada da Netherlands, yayin da Anna Jochemsen ta kammala a ta tara a jerin ajin mata a Super-G jiya, da Finland yayin da Katja ke kammalawa a na goma duk a bikin.
translations.hypothesis: دا شامل هولاندا, مالي Anna Jochemsen ta kammala sababi na kasta a gasar Super-G, kuma فنلاند, مالي Katja Saarinen ta kammala sababi na kasta a wannan gasa.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mitchell Gourley na Ostiraliya ya gama na goma sha ɗaya a cikin tsayuwar Super-G na maza. Ɗan gasar Czech Oldrich Jelinek ya gama na goma sha shida a cikin Super-G na zaunen maza.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley na Australia ينهي في المركز الحادي عشر في تتابع Super-G للرجالا.  competitor Oldrich Jelinek na Czech ينهي في المركز السادس عشر في تتابع Super-G للرجالا.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez na kasar Mexico ya ƙare a matsayin na goma sha biyar a jerin Super-G na maza na zaune. Adam Hall na New Zealand ya ƙare a matsayin na tara a Suƙer-G na maza na tsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez, سيا من المكسيك, ينهي في الموضع الخامس عشر في تتابع Super-G مالي. Adam Hall, سيا من نيوزيلاند, ينهي في الموضع التاسع في تتابع Super-G مالي.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mazaje na Poland masu fama da rashin gani a wasan ƙwallon ƙafa Maciej Krezel da jagorar Anna Ogarzynska sun gama na goma sha uku a gasar Super-G. Jong Seork Park na Koriya ta Kudu ya kammala na ashirin da huɗu a gasar maza ta Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: الرياضي البولندي ذو الإعاقة البصرية، ماسيج كرازيل، ومرشدته، آنا أوجارزنسكا، يغلوبوا في المركز الثالث عشر في تتابع Super-G. رياضي كوريا الجنوبية، جونغ سيروك بارك، يغلوبوا في المركز العشرين في تتابع Super-G للرجال.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Ana tuhumar ma'aikatun majalisar dinkin duniya da suka zo Haiti bayan girgizar kasar shekarar2010 da yada cutuka wayenda suka fara ne daga kusa da mazaunar su.
translations.hypothesis: "الأفراد العاملون في قوات حفظ السلام التابعة للأمم المتحدة، اللواتي جائو إلى هايتي بعد زلزال 2010، يُتهمون بكونهم المسؤولين عن انتشار الوباء، الذي بدأ بالقرب من موقع التمركز الخاص بهم.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: A cewar karar, ba a tsaftace bata daga zangon UN kamar yadda ya kamata ba, ya haddasa kwayoyin cuta shigan ruwa wadda yake kwarara cikin Rafin Artibonite, daya daga ciki babba a Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: حسب ما هو مذكور في دعوى, الفضلات التي تم جمعها من معسكر الأمم المتحدة لم يتم تنظيفها بشكل صحيح, مما أدى إلى دخول بكتيريا إلى مجرى نهر آرتيبوني، وهو أحد أكبر الأنهار في هايتي.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Kafin isowar sojoji, Haiti bata taba fuskantar matsalolin da suka shafi cutar ba tun a shekarun 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: قبل مجيء والق, هايتي لم يواجه مشاكله المرتكزة على الأمراض تال ذلك، تال عام 1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Cibiyar Tabbatar da Adalci da Demokradiyya ta ƙasar Haiti ta nakalto waɗansu ayyukan nazari masu zaman kansu waɗanda ke tsammanin bataliyar kiyaye zaman lafiya ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke Nepal ce ta kawo cutar Haiti bisa rashin sani.
translations.hypothesis: مؤسسة هائيتان لعدالة و ديمقراطيya تاي سيا، أشاروا إلى براءات بحثي، اللاتي تظهر أن وحدة حفظ السلام التابعة للأمم المتحدة، من نيبال، قد جلبوا بمرورًا الأمراض إلى هائيتان، دون أن يدركوا ذلك.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, ƙwararriyar masaniyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kan cutar, ta bayyana cewa mai yiyuwa ne sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya suka haifar da cutar.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ؤستاذ نا UN بـ wannan matsala, ya ce cewa, "غالبًا ما wannan shiga yana a matsu ne ta hannun masu zaman ki."

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Marar lafiyar ya je Najeriya, inda aka samu wasu sun kamu da cutar ta Ebola.
translations.hypothesis: المرضى قد زاروا نيجيريا، حيث تكررت بضعة قضايا لمرض إيبولا.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Asibitin ta bi ka’idoji na kula da kamuwa da cuta, tare da raba masu jiyya daga sauran jama’a domin hana yaduwan cutan.
translations.hypothesis: سنا، سيمه يالليل, لـم يتبنى الأساليب الموصى بها لـمكافحة داء, بـما في ذلك عزل مريض مـن باقي الأفراد, لـمـنع احتمال انتقال داء لـهم.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Kafin Simpsons Simon ya yi aiki a kan shirye-shirye da yawa a wurare daban-daban.
translations.hypothesis: "Zaman da Simon ya shiga The Simpsons, yana da shekaru da ya yi a many rahoton, a mukashe-mukashe.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: A lokacin 1980s yayi aiki a kan shirye-shirye kamar Taxi, Cheers, da The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1980s, yana aikin shirin-shirin kamar "Taxi", "Cheers", da "The Tracy Ullman Show".

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: A cikin 1989 ya taimaka ƙirƙirar Simpsons tare da Brooks da Groening, kuma shi ke da alhakin ɗaukar ƙungiyar masu rubutu na farko.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1989, yana cikin יוז, ساعد في الإنتاج ديال "The Simpsons" مع بروكس و غرونينغ، و كان مسؤول عن تعيين الفريق الأولي ديال كاتب المسلسل.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Duk da barin wasan shirin a 1993 an cigaba da kiransa shugaban shiri, kuma ya cigaba da karbar miliyoyin daloli a kowace kaka na kamasho.
translations.hypothesis: حتى وغم غياره من البرنامج عام 1993، هو لا يزال يمتلك لقب منتج تنفيذي، و لا يزال يتلقى مبالغ طائلة، تزيد عن مئات الملايين من الدولارات، كل موسم، كأجر.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Tun farko kamfanin dillacin labarai na China Xinhua ya ba da rahoton wani jirgin da aka sace.
translations.hypothesis: A wani lokaci, gazata ta China, Xinhua, ta rahoto cewa jirgin ɗabiya ya zama bishiya.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Rahotanni daga baya sun nuna cewa an yi wa jirgin barazanar harin bam, sannan aka karkatar da shi zuwa Afghanistan, inda ya sauka a Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: "шин ма'lumat sun гарга, ساس ɗan ƙasa ya karɓa ƙarin ƙungiyar, kuma ya ɗaura zuwa Afghanistan, inda ya kai a Kandahar."

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Rahotannin farko sun ce an juya akalar jirgin zuwa Afghanistan bayan an hana shi saukar gaggawa a Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: التقارير المبكرة تظهر أن الطائرة وُضعت في مسار آخر إلى أفغانستان بعد رفض السماح لها الهبوط في حالة طارئة في يورمقي.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Hadarin jirgin sama ya zama ruwan dare a Iran, sakamakon tsoffin jirage wadanda ba a kula da su na ayyukan farar hula da sojoji.
translations.hypothesis: غوامبو ؤغاري نا cikin إيران, wanda yake da jiraje da ke ƙidanci, kuma ba za a ɗau su ba, ga ayyuka na shaharar da kuma ayyuka na kasa.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Takunkumin ƙasa da ƙasa na nufin ba za a iya sayan sabon jirgin sama ba.
translations.hypothesis: القيود الدولية لزاما لقول، ألا لا يمكن شراؤ طائرات جديدة.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Aerosmith sun soke sauran kade-kade a yawon shakatawansu.
translations.hypothesis: گروപ്പिन Aerosmith sun гана, концерт ɗansu na ƙarshe a safarinsu.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Ƙungiyar makaɗan rock za ta fara yawon kaɗe-kaɗe a Amurka da Canada har zuwa 16 ga Satumba.
translations.hypothesis: غرووب الموسيقي يخطط لزيارة الولايات المتحدة و كندا حتى 16 أيلول.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Sun soke yawon shakatawa bayan fitaccen mawaƙi Steven Tyler ya ji rauni bayan ya faɗo daga fage yayin wasan a ranar 5 ga watan Agusta.
translations.hypothesis: فقد بطلوا wannan يور، بعد ما المغني رئي، ستيفن تايل، سُكّت بعد ما سقط من المسرح بينما كان يغني م 5.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Murray ya rasa saiti na farko a bugun tazara bayan duka maza sun rike kowane mai hidimtawa a cikin saitin.
translations.hypothesis: Murray يخسر الب set, bayan da wataƙali ya yi, kamar da wata, a cikin wannan set.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro ya samu riba a sa na biyu, amma wannan shima na bukatan tie break bayan an kai 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro يَرزح له‌ cikin సెٽ, কিন্তু wannan زاما لزوم يَرجي 6-6, دابه‌ر.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro ya sami kulawa a kafadarsa a wannan lokacin amma ya sami nasarar komawa wasan.
translations.hypothesis: Potro لاсом wannan, amma يإمكان يواສາ جرا, و يإمكان يواສາ cikin لاره.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: An fara shirin da karfe 8:30 na yamma (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: البرنامج يې شুর, 8:30bn (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Shahararun mawaka a faɗin ƙasar sun gabatar da bhajans, ko wakokin ibada, zuw ga kafafun Shri Sham.
translations.hypothesis: مغنيين مشهورون بجميع أنحاء البلد، قدّموا "باجان"، أى غناء ديني، لـ "شري شيايم".

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Mawaki Sarju Sharma, shi ya fara a maraicen sannan sai Shankar Choudhary ya biyo baya da Chhappan Bhog Bhajan ya biyo su. Mawaki, Raju Khandelwal yana raka shi.
translations.hypothesis: المغني سانجو شارما مطلع, يتبعه جاي شانكار تشودھاري. كما قام بتقديم "تشاپان بوغ بوجان". المغني راجو خاندلواال كان يرافقه.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Sannan, sai Lakkha Singh ya yi jagora a rera waƙar bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: "לאحقًا، لاکشا سينغ سار زاك في غناء البجاన్స్."

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Farantai 108 na Chhappan Bhog (a Indiyanci, kayan abinci daban-daban gud 56, kamar, Alewa, ƴaƴan itace, masu kwanso, abinci da sauran su waɗanda aka bayar ga abin bauta) ga Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: 108 لوح "تشاப்பன் بوغ" (في الهندوسية، 56 مواد تాయిلا, kamar, حلويات, فواكه, حبات, أطباق, وغير ذلك, اللاتي يُقدمن لاله) لـ بابا شيام.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh ya kuma gabatar da Chhappan Bhog Bhajan. Singer da Raju Khandelwal yana rakiyarsa.
translations.hypothesis: لکھا سينج ي اضافة "تشابن بوغ" تاي، و ياش، راجو خاندلवाल ي يرافوه.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: A lokacin gabatar da babban bayani na ranar Alhamis a Nunin Wasan Tokyo, shugaban Nintendo Satoru Iwata ya kaddamar da tsarin sarrafawa na sabuwar na’urar Nintendo Re volution.
translations.hypothesis: A matakan binciken "Tokyo Game Show" a ranar Alhamdu, President na Nintendo, Satoru Iwata, ya bayyana ƙirar ƙaɓar da za a iya amfani da ita da sabon kwamfuta na Nintendo, "Nintendo Revolution".

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Kamar makunnin talabijin, makunnin abun yana amfani da sanser biyu da aka jona kusa da talabijin din don a iya gane inta take.
translations.hypothesis: "هذا جهاز يشبه جهاز التحكم الخاص بالتلفزيون، ويستعمل جهازان سنسور, اللذان ساوغ لقرابة تليفزيون, ليحدد مكانه في فضاء ثلاثي الأبعاد."

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Wannan zai bai wa masu wasannin bidiyo damar sarrafa wasan ta hanyar motsi da na’urar a cikin iska.
translations.hypothesis: هذا سيمكن بازوكا من التحكم في الأفعال والحركات في ألعاب الفيديو عن طريق تحريك الجهاز في الهواء.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: Motar Giancarlo Fisichella ta kwace masa inda hakan ya jawo fitarsa daga tseren jim kaɗan bayan farawa.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella يسيطر على سرعته، ولكنه يسيطر عليه، و ينهي السباق cikin ƴan lokaci bayan fara.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Abokin wasansa Fernando Alonso shi ne kan gaba a mafi wasane, amma ya tsaya bayan dakatawar zango, watakila saboda lanƙwashewar wilin tayar gaba na ɓangaren dama ne.
translations.hypothesis: رفيق بازي، فرناندو ألونسو, كان رائد أغلب ووقت السب، ولكنه ينهي السب بعد التوقف, وربما بسبب عجلت اليمين الأمامية التي لم تكن مثبتة بشكل صحيح.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ya gama tserensa ba da daɗewa ba bayan Alonso, saboda lalacewar dakatarwa a yaƙe-yaƙe da yawa yayin tseren.
translations.hypothesis: مايكل شومخر ينهي غلبته, سريعا بعد أن ألونسو, بسبب عطل نظام التخميد, ووهذا ناتج عن النزاعات الاري التي دارت خلال السباق.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: “Tana da kyau sannan tana waka da kyau, kuma,” ya bayana bisa ga kwafi na taron masu yada labaru.
translations.hypothesis: "ع un, yana da kyau kuma yana غناء cikin ɓayen," wannan shine ماء، kamar yadda ana ɓata cikin majiya na labarin.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.

translations.hypothesis: لكن، لا يُعتقد أن هؤلاء قد تسببوا في أي ضرر لمركب الفضاء.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK ta kuma ruwaito cewa masana’antar samar da makamashin nukiliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa a gundumar Niigata tana aiki yadda yakamata.
translations.hypothesis: NHK likewise ta bayani cewa, sabon zangina na nukliyar Kashiwazaki Kariwa a jihar Niigata yana aiki kamar yadda ya kamata.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Kamfanin Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ya ba da rahoton babu wata illa daga girgizar kasar kuma an rufe matatar mai lamba 1 da 2 a tashar makamashin nukiliyar ta Shika.
translations.hypothesis: Kampanyin Yantawa na Hokuriku ta bayyana cewa ba komai da lalata ya faru bayan farashun, kuma an dakatar da masu samar da jiki na 1 da 2 a gasar nukliya ta Shika.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: An ba da rohoto cewa gidaje 9400 a yankin ba su da ruwa sannan kusan 100 ba su da lantarki.
translations.hypothesis: التقارير تظهر أن ما لا يقل عن 9400 بيت في wannan yankin لا يملكون سرير, و حوالي 100 بيت لا يملكون زन्.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Wasu hanyoyi sun lalace, al'amuran jirgin kasa ya katse a wuraren da abin ya shafa, kuma Filin jirgin saman Noto da ke yankin Ishikawa ya kasance a rufe.
translations.hypothesis: Фак, ба Bankin sun lalace, ساƙon rail yana cikin wahala a wajen da ya shafi, kuma ɗigon Noto a jihar Ishikawa yana da wani.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Wani bam ɗaya ya fashe a wajen ofishin gwamna-janar.
translations.hypothesis: "فوج انفجار ؤدا خوارجي مكتب رئيس وزراء."

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Karin Bama-bamai uku sun fashe kusa a gine-ginen gwamnati a cikin tsawon sa’aoi biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Sababbin bom, biyu, sun fita kusa da babbanofin, cikin makon biyu.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Wasu rahotanni sun kai adadin mutuwan zuwa takwas, kuma tabbatacciyar rahoto na tabbatar da cewa mutum 30 suka ji rauni; amma ba a san adadin ƙarshe ba.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Dukkanin cyanuric acid da melamine an same su ne a cikin kayan fitsari daga dabbobin gidan da suka mutu bayan sun sha gurbataccen abincin dabbobi.
translations.hypothesis: Cyanuric acid da melamine, sun kasance a عينات البول daga ƙwayar wuta, bayan su cin ababin abinci wanda ya kasance da ƙwaya.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Magungunan biyu suna aiki tare da juna don samar da lu'ulu'u wanda zai iya toshe aikin koda, masu bincike a jami'ar sun ce.
translations.hypothesis: الأدوية الأغلب تتفاعل مع بعضها البعض لإنتاج بلورات, اللاتي قد يمنع عمل الكلى, هكذا قال الباحثون في الجامعة.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kiristal sun taru a fisarin kyanwa ta hanyar karin sinadarin melanin da cyanuric.
translations.hypothesis: الباحثون يلاحظون يوب، سائل البول، يظهر بلورات بعد הוספת ملامين وأحماض سيانوريك.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Jumlar sanfurin gilashin suna kama da wanda aka samu a fitsarin dabbar yayin da aka kafa a na’urar infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: التركيب هؤلاء الأجسام يتطابق مع تلك الموجودة في البول البحي، عند مقارنتها باستخدام التحليل الطيفي بالأشعة تحت الحمراء (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Ban sani ba ko kun gane shi ko a'a, amma yawancin kayayyaki daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo wannan ƙasa ba tare da biyan haraji ba.
translations.hypothesis: أنا لست متأكد إذا كوك أو لا، لكن أغلب البضائع المأتي من أمريكا الوسطى, لا توجد عليها رسوم جمركية.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Duk da haka kashi tamanin cikin kayan mu sun samu haraji a kasashen Amurka ta tsakiya. Zamu kula da kai.
translations.hypothesis: لكن 80% مِن סلعنّا كان لهن جرايف (ضريبة) في مநாكب ؤلأمريكا. سَنعاملنكي

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Na kasa fahimtar abin, hakika babu adalci a ciki.
translations.hypothesis: ذالاء لم تبدو منطقية لِي; بالتأكيد لاء يا.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Kawai abin da na ke ce wa mutane shine ku bi da mu yadda muke bi da ku.
translations.hypothesis: كل ما ناي قول ل mutanen shine, "تا يا عাউ يان, يان يان."

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gwamnan California Arnold Schwarzenegger ya sanya hannu a cikin wata doka da ta hana sayarwa ko hayar wasannin bidiyo mai tashin hankali ga ƙananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: الجناب الرئيس بولاية كاليفورنيا، آرنولد شوازنيجر، قد يوقّع قانون يمنع ن vendita أو تأجير ألعاب الفيديو العنيفة لشباب.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Dokar na bukatar a sanya wa wasannin bidiyo na tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California alama da ke nuna “18” inda ya zamo sayar da su ga kananan yara laifi ne mai jawo hukuncin tarar $1000 a kowane laifi.
translations.hypothesis: القانون يطلب ألعاب الفيديو العنيفة المبيعة في ولاية كاليفورنيا، أن تكون عليها ملصق يقرأ "18"، وبيعها لشخص قاصر يُعاقب بغرامة 1000 دولار لكل مخالفة.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Darektan gabatar da kara na hukumar, Kier Starmer QC, a safiyar yau ya sanar da gurfanar da mutanen biyu, Huhne da Pryce, a gaban shari’a.
translations.hypothesis: الرئيس التنفيذي للمحاكم، كير ستارمر، قد صرح في الساعات الأولى من هذا اليوم، بالإعلان عن اتهام كل من هونه و بريس.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Huhne ya yi murabus kuma za a maye gurbinsa a Majalisar da Dan Majalisa Ed Davey. Ana tsammanin Dan Majalisa Norman Lamb zai zama Ministan Kasuwanci aikin da Job Davey zai ajiye.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne قد استقال، و سيتم تعيين Ed Davey، سكرتار عام، ليلحق مكانه في مجلس الوزراء. يُعتقد أن Norman Lamb، سكرتار عام، سيتولى منصب وزير الاعمال الذي سيتركه Davey.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: Huhne da Pryce an shirya za su bayyana a Kotun Majistare ta Westminster a ranar 16 ga Fabrairu.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne و Pryce sun kammala shiga cikin bima na Westminster Magistrates Court a ranar 16 ga Fabrairu.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Wandanda suka rasu sun hada da Nicholas Alden dan shekara 25, da Zachary Cuddeback mai shekara 21. Cuddeback ya kasance mai tukin.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: Martelly ya rantsar da sabuwar Kwamitin Zabe na Wucin-gadi (CEP) mai membobi guda tara.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly يوسف يوسف، أمس، قد وعه على مجلس انتخابي مؤقت جديد (CEP) ذو تسعة أعضاء.

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: Shi ne CEP Matelly na biyar cikin shekara hudu.
translations.hypothesis: هذه هي المرة الخامسة التي يخدم فيها مارتيلي منصبه كرئيس مجلس إدارة CEP, cikin 4 shekara.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: A watan da ya gabata ne wani kwamiti na shugaban kasa ya ba da shawarar murabus din CEP tun gabani a matsayin bangare na kunshin daukar matakan ciyar da kasar gaba zuwa sabon zabe.

translations.source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.reference: Kwamitin ya kasance martanin Martelly ne game da yaɗuwar zanga-zangar adawa da tsarin mulki da aka fara a watan Oktoba.
translations.hypothesis: wannan kwamiti, ita ta kasance hanyar Martelly don lalata sha'awar masu zaman gidan, wanda ta fara a watan Oktoba.

translations.source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.reference: Zanga-zangar da wani lokaci suke da tashin hankali sun faru ne saboda gaza yin zaɓuɓɓuka, waɗansu lokacinsu ya wuce tun 2011.
translations.hypothesis: "الأعمال المظاهرات، اللاتي لا زال يرتكبون عنف، هما نتيجة عدم إجراء الانتخابات، بض منها تسببت في 2011."

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: Ma’aikatar tattalin arziki, Ciniki da Masana’antu ta Japan (METI) ta ce tana sane da hatsarurruka guda 27 da ke da alaƙa da na’urorin.
translations.hypothesis: وزارة الاقتصادي، التجارة والصناعة (METI) ta Japan ta ce cewa, ta san 27 عواصف اللاتي ناجمن عن هؤدا الأجهزة.

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: A makon da ya gabata, METI ta sanar da cewa Apple ya sanar da shi wasu karin lamura masu zafi fiye da 34, wadanda kamfanin ya kira “marasa mahimmanci.”
translations.hypothesis: أسبوع الأخير، METI (وزارة البيئة، الطاقة، والتنمية المستدامة) أعلنت أن شركة Apple قد أبلغتهن عن 34 حوادث إضافية تتعلق بتسخين، اللاتي الشركة عُرفتهم بـ "غير مهمة".

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Kungiyar tsaron ta bada martani da kiran daga bayanin na Appe "abun bakin-ciki"
translations.hypothesis: وزارت قد أجابت بذكر أن تعليق شركة Apple لاحالة التقرير "هو أمر ضائع حقًا".

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Girgizan kasa ta bugi Mariana da karfe 07:19 na safe (09:19 p.m. GMT Juma’a).
translations.hypothesis: الزلزال يضرب مدينة ماريانا م, الساعة 07:19bn (الساعة 09:19bn, الجمعة, GMT).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ofishin gudanarwar da aikin gaggawa na Northern Marianas ya ce babu rohoton barna da aka samu a ƙasar.
translations.hypothesis: مكتب إدارة الطوارئ في ولايات الشمال قد صرح أن لا توجد أضرار التي تم الإبلاغ عنها في البلاد.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Haka kuma Cibiyar Fitar da Gargaɗi kan Tsunami ta yankin Pacific ta sanar da cewa babu alamar Tsunami.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، ممركز الإنذار بشأن زلزال المحيط الهادئ قد صرح بأنه لا يوجد أي دليل على حدوث زلزال.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Wani tsohon dan sanda na Philippines ya tsare mutanen da ke yawon bude ido a Hong Kong ta hanyar satar motar bas din su a Manila, babban birnin Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: سابق ضابط الشرطة فلبيني قد ڦسرت سياح من هونغ كونغ بـ اختطاف حافيتوهن في مانيلا، عاصرة الفلبين.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: Ronaldo Mendoza ya harba bindigarsa samfurin M16 akan ‘yan yawon shaƙatawar.
translations.hypothesis: روlando ميندودا، سياح, ساندوهو هازه‌ yake M16.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: An ceto da dama cikin wadanda aka yi garkuwa da su din, yayin da aka tabbatar da mutuwar akalla guda shida daga cikinsu ya zuwa yanzu.
translations.hypothesis: أكثر من ناكبي قد تم إنقاذهم، و حتى الآن، لا less than ست ناكبي قد تم تأكيد وفاتهم.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: An saki mutane shida da aka yi garkuwa da su, ciki har da yara da tsofaffi da wuri, da kuma masu daukar hoto na Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: Lafatafun shida, gami ga ana da masu zaman sha da masu gari, sun samu azki, kamar da masu ɗaukar surausuwa na Filipino.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Masu daukar hoto daga baya sun maye gurbin wata tsohuwa saboda tana bukatar dakin wankan. An bindige Mendoza.
translations.hypothesis: لاحقا, masu koyawa suka ɗauki wata mata mai shekara kamar ta bukata wata, saboda ta so ta yi wanka. Mendoza ya kashe.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins yabi sahun baban shi ya zabi aikin likitanci.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins يتبعه أسلوب والده، ويدخل إلى مهنة الطب.

translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Ya sami horo a matsayin likitan fannin haihuwa kuma ya fara aiki a Asibitin Mata na Ƙasa da ke Auckland a shekarar 1959.
translations.hypothesis: وَلَهُ يَرَى َعَلَى اِسْتِيتْبا و يَدُورُ إلى عَمَل فِي مُستشفى اِسْتِيتْبا الوطني لنساء فِي اِسْتْكلاند عام 1959.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: A yayin da yake aiki a asibitin, liggins ya fara bincike akan yin nakuda da wurin a lokacin da baya aiki.
translations.hypothesis: حين كان يخدم في سيماري، ليجينس بداء البحث عن ولادة مبكرة בזמן فراغه.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Bincikensa ya nuna cewa idan an yi amfani da maganin hormone zai hanzarta nuna kosawar huhun jaririn.
translations.hypothesis: البحث שלו يظهر أن، إذا كان هرمون يُعطى، يُمكّن من تسريع نضوج الرئة للطفل.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua ya bayar da rahoton cewa masu binciken gwamnati sun gano na’urorin naɗar sauti biyu na 'bakin akwatin’ ranar Laraba.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua ta rahoto cewa masu binciken hukuma sun gano dua "kotak na bayar" na tafiya a ranar Alhamdu.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Abokan kokawar Luna sun yi jimamin mutuwar ta.
translations.hypothesis: و ياو, با बाकी masu jihar, sun yi min sha'awa ga Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer yace "Luna ta kasance Sarauniyar Tsaurarawa. manaja ta ta farko. Luna ta mutu ne a daren wata guda biyu. Abu na musamman kamar ita. mace mai jajircewa."
translations.hypothesis: توماي دريمر قال: "لونا هي ملوك Extreme na farko. Malamin na farko. لونا قد ماتت ليلة يوما. ؤيا ؤيا، تاي ؤيا، kamar wannan. ؤيا ؤيا."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Dustin “Goldust” Runnels ta yi sharhi cewa “Luna ta kasance mai rauni sosai kamar ni ... wataƙila ma fiye da haka ... ƙaunace ta zai batar da ita ... da fatan tana cikin wuri mafi kyau.”
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels يوه، "Luna تانا kamar ni...حتى زai...نافيها kuma zan kashe...نا يالله تانا cikin wani wuri mai kyau."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Daga cikin mutane 1,400 da aka jefa kuri’a gabanin zaben tarayya na 2010, wadanda ke adawa da Australia ta zama jamhuriya sun karu da kashi 8 cikin 100 tun daga shekarar 2008.
translations.hypothesis: دار cikin 1,400 رانسوم نا shiga cikin 2010, wadanda ke kafe cewa أستراليا تاي زاي تكون جمهور، sun karu da 8% tun 2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: Minista mai rikon kwarya Julia Gillard ta yi ikirarin a lokacin yakin neman zaben shekarar 2010 cewa ya yi imani Australia za ta zama jamhuriya a karshen mulkin Sarauniya Elizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: الرئيسي، جوليا جيلارد، بـ خلال ولايات الانتخابات الفيدرالية لعام 2010، زعم أن هي تعتقد أن أستراليا يجب أن تصبح جمهورية بعد انتهاء ولاية الملكة إليزابيث الثانية.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: kashi 34 na wadanda ke cikin jin ra’ayoyin suna da ra’ayi kamar wannan, son Sarauniya Elizabeth II ta zama mai sarauta ta karshe a Australia.
translations.hypothesis: 34% daga masu анketan na, yana da wannan راي, wanda yake ىريد أن الملكة إليزابيث الثانية تكون آخر ملكة لـ أستراليا.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Jin ra’ayoyin jama’a ya nuna cewa kaso 29 na mutanen Australiya na goyon bayan zamanta jamhuriyya cikin gaggawa yayin da kaso 31 kuma ke sukar ra’ayin ta zama jamhuriya.
translations.hypothesis: غاي wannan анケート, 29% daga masu анケート يظنوا أن أستراليا يجب أن تصبح جمهورية في أقرب وقت ممكن, بينما 31% يظنوا أن أستراليا لا ينبغي أبدًا أن تصبح جمهورية.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Wanda ya lashe lambar zinare a gasar Olympics ya kamata ne ya yi iyo a tseren mita 100 da 200 kuma a cikin wasanni uku a wasannin Commonwealth, amma saboda korafin da ya yi ya nuna shakku kan lafiyar sa.
translations.hypothesis: الرياضي الفائز بميدالية ذهبية في الألعاب الأولمبية كان من المفترض أن يشارك في سباقات 100 متر و 200 متر حرة، وكذلك في ثلاثة سباقات جماعية في الألعاب الكومنولث، ولكنه بسبب شكوكه، صحته قد أصبحت موضع تساؤل.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Mutane da yawa sun tantance abin da aka gano ta amfani da sassa da kwakwalwar na’ura daban-daban a farkon Fabrairu kuma an ba da sanarwar ranar Talata.
translations.hypothesis: 'Ƙaɗai mutanen da ke gwamnawa, da kuma amfani da hanyar kwamputa da software, tun daga farkon Fabrairu, kuma wannan rahoton ya watsa a ranar Tuesday.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Mai yiwuwa taurari masu wutsiya sun kasance ta cikinsu ruwan sama ke zuwa duniya tare da takin dabbobi wanda ke iya samar da kayan gina jiki domin tallafar rayuwa.
translations.hypothesis: "يا محتمل أَن كومتس (Comets) كان يمثل مصدر تزويد مياه للأرض، بالإضافة إلى مادات عضوية اللاتي دايو يكو البروتين ويدعموا حياه."

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Masana kimiyya suna fatan fahimtar yadda taurari suke samuwa, musamman yadda Duniya ta samu, tunda taurari masu wutsiya suka yi karo da duniya lokaci mai tsawo da ya gabata.
translations.hypothesis: العلماء يأملون أن يفهموا كيف تتشكل كواكب، وخاصة كيف تشكلت الأرض، بما أن الكوميت قد اصطدمت بالأرض في الماضي.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Cuomo, mai shekaru 53, ya fara mulkin sa a farkon wannan shekarar kuma ya sanya hannu kan wata doka a watan da ya halatta auren jinsi.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, البالغ من العمر 53 عامًا، بدأ فترة ولايته في مطلع هذا العام، ووقّع على قانون الأسبوع الماضي، الذي يسمح بزواج بين أشخاص من نفس الجنس.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Ya kira jita-jitar da cewa “hirar siyasa da wauta”.
translations.hypothesis: و يَرى هؤلائي روايات نَجَل، "كلام سياسي و هراء".

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Ana hasashen zai tsaya takarar shugaban kasa a 2016.
translations.hypothesis: Ana tsammanar cewa zai ɗauki shirin zama shugaban kwamanda a 2016.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.reference: NextGen tsari ne wanda FAA ke ikirarin zai bawa jirgin sama damar yin gajeren hanyoyi da kuma adana miliyoyin galan na mai a kowace shekara da kuma yanke hayakin mai.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen هي نظام الذي وكالة الطيران الفيدرالية (FAA) يزعم أنه سيسمح لمركبات جوية أن تطير مسارات أقصر، وتوفير ميا millions من جالون من الوقود كل عام، و تقليل انبعاثات ثاني أكسيد الكربون.

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: Yana amfani da fasahar tauraron dan adam maimakon amfani da rada a doron kasa domin baiwa masu kula da zirga zirgar jiragen sama damar gane inda jirage su ke babu kuskure ta yadda za su iya baiwa matukan jirgin sama cikakkun bayanai.
translations.hypothesis: ذو يرتكز على تكنولوجيا القمر الصناعي, ضارًا مَع التكنولوجيا البسيطة, تَعْنِي أن مُشغلي ترافيك جوي, يُمكِنون تحديد طائرات بِدقة, و يوصي لأصحاب الطائرات مَع معلومات دقيقة.

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Ba a kara ababen hawa ba, sannan jirgin kasa da ba na karkashin kasa ba, ba zai tsaya a wimbledon ba, sannan babu wajen ajiye motoci da na hawan motoci a wurin.
translations.hypothesis: لا توجد وسيلة نقل تضاف، وخطوط تريب عادية لا ستتوقف عند ويمنبي، و لا توجد أمكنة لترك السيارات وخدمة "park-and-ride" في wannan wuri.

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Tsoron rashin isassun motocin zirga zirga na iya tilasta a yi wasan ba tare da yan kallo sun halarta ba.
translations.hypothesis: القلق بشأن عدم وجود وسيلة نقل، قد أدى إلى إمكانية أن الفريق يضطر إلى التنافس في شأن خاص، دون دعم من مشجعين.

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Wani bincike da aka wallafa ranar Alhamis a mujallar Science ya ba da rohoto kan samuwar wani sabon jintsin tsuntsaye a Tsibiran Galapagos na Ecuadoria.
translations.hypothesis: أحد البحث الذي نُشر فيursday في مجلة Science، يورّط عن ظهور نوع جديد من الطيور على جزر Galápagos في الإكوادور.

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Princeton da ke Amurka da kuma Jami'ar Uppsala da ke Sweden sun ba da rahoton cewa sabon jinsin ya samo asali ne a tsararraki biyu kawai, duk da cewa an yi imani da cewa wannan aikin zai dauki lokaci mai tsawo, saboda yaduwar da ke tsakanin tsaunin Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, da kuma bakin kakakus. finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: 'Masu nazarin daga Makademiya ta Princeton a Amurika da Makademiya ta Uppsala a Sweden, sun bayyana cewa wannan nau'in da ɓoyayen ta taso cikin makon biyu, duk da cewa ana ɗaukar wannan aikin yana ɗauke da lokaci da yadda. wannan ne saboda ɓoyayen da ke da su, Geospiza fortes, da ɓoyayen da suka shiga, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Lemun kabeji na canza launin bisa yanayin yawan acid ko alkaline din ma’adanin.
translations.hypothesis: جوشurin kababai yana canza launin, ta wurin cire ko ƙasa (alkali) na kimiyyar.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Ana nuna matakin pH ta hanyar yawan sinadarin Hydrogen (na H a cikin pH) kwayoyin dake cikin sunadaran da aka gwada.
translations.hypothesis: مستوى pH يُشار إليه بمقدار أيون هيدروجين (حرف H في pH) الموجود في الكيميائي الم untersucht.

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Sinadiran Hydrogen sune proton wadanda suka cire wa Electrons (tunda sunadaran Hydrogen sun kunshi proton daya da electron daya).
translations.hypothesis: أيونات هيدروجين هما بروتون, اللائي قد خُفّف منهن إلكترون (لأن ذرات الهيدروجين تتكون من بروتون واحد و إلكترون واحد).

translations.reference: Laimar da ke hannayenka za ta haɗe da fatar waje, inda zai zama abin nishaɗi kuma zai haifar da wani rin kwanso.
translations.hypothesis: الرطوبة الموجودة على يداك ستتفاعل مع الطبقة الخارجية، وهذا سيبدو غريب ويشكل نوعًا من قشرة.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Biranen Harappa da Mohenjo-daro suna da banɗaki mai ruwa a kusan kowane gida, wanda su ke haɗe wani kyakkyawa tsarin magudanar najasa.
translations.hypothesis: المدن هاربابا و موهينجو-داره، كان لديهما حمام يرمي ماء، الموجود في تقريبًا كل بيت، وذو نظام صرف صحي متطور.

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: An samo ragowar tsarin shara a gidajen biranen Minoan na Crete da Santorini da ke Girka.
translations.hypothesis: أثار من بقايا أنظمة صرف المياه ناغاسو في داران لمدينة مينوان في كريت و سانتوري، ببلد اليونان.

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Hakanan akwai bandakuna a zamanin d Misira, Farisa da China. A cikin wayewar Roman, wasu lokuta bayan gida wani bangare ne na gidajen wanka na jama'a inda maza da mata suke tare a cikin haɗin gwiwa.
translations.hypothesis: هناك أيضًا غرف غسل في مصر القديمة، فارس، و الصين.  في الحضارة الرومانية، غرف غسل كان لبعض الأحيان جزءًا من مراكز حمام عام، حيث رداء الذكور و الإناث معًا.

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Tauraron dan adam a sararin samaniya yana samun kira sannan yana nuna shi baya ƙasa, kusan nan take.
translations.hypothesis: الناقل الموجود في الفضاء يรับ پیام, وبعد ذلك يبعثه مرة أخرى, cikin ɓangaren ƙasa, cikin ɗaya.

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: An aika tauraron dan adam zuwa sararin samaniya ta hanyar roka. Masana kimiyya suna amfani da madubin hangen nesa a sararin samaniya saboda yanayin duniya yana gurbata wasu haskenmu da kallo.
translations.hypothesis: الناقل (satellite) يرسل إلى الفضاء ساس قاذف. الباحثين يرتدون تلسكوب في الفضاء، لكي يتمكنوا من رؤية بوضوح، لكي جو الأرض يغير بعض الضوء ونظرتنا.

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: Yana daukan katon kunbo fiye da tsawon kafa 100 domin sanya tauraron dan adam ko abin kawo nesa kusa a sararin sama.
translations.hypothesis: لإرسال قمر أو تلسكوب إلى الفضاء، لابد من استخدام صاروكي عظيم، يرتفع إلى ارتفاع 100 قدم.

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Gare garen ta canza duniyan a hanyoyi na ban mamaki. Abu mafi girma da gare garen ta yi mana shine ta bamu hanyoyi masu sauki na sufuri.
translations.hypothesis: غلاف قد غيّر عالمه بأساليب مذهلة. البداية التي غلاف قد أتاح لنا هي وسيلة نقل أسهل وأسرع.

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: Lamarin ne ya kawo mana jirgin kasa, mota da hanyoyin sufuri da dama.

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: Karkashin su akwai wasu maguna masu matsakaicin yanayi wadanda ke cin abinci mai madaidaicin yanayi wanda ya fara daga zomaye zuwa barewa da barewan daji.
translations.hypothesis: حوله ها، ساروا قطҳои ƙasa, wanda suna kuma kuma kula da abubuwa masu tsarki, daga ƙarar zuwa ƙarar, da kuma ƙarar.

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: Da karshe, akwai kananan kyanwoyi (da suka haɗa da kyanwoyin gida da suka gudu) da suke cin kananan naman da suka kama kamar kwari, ɓeraye, kadangaru, da tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: وأخيرًا، هناك العديد من القوارض الصغير (بما في ذلك القوارض غير المنضبطة) اللاتي يأكلن طعام، سوسو، حشرات، سحلية، وطيور، اللاتي هما شائعات.

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Sirrin nasararsu ita ce tsarinsu na samun hutu, aiki na musamman da kowace kyanwa ke riko da shi domin kaucewa yin gasa da sauran.
translations.hypothesis: سري لنجاح su shine فكرة "الخاصية"، وهي وظيفه خاصه چې تايح لكل قط، وتجعلها تلا من التنافس مع ساكنين.

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Zakuna ne dangin mage da suka fi daɗin ma’amala, suna taruwa wuri ɗaya abin da ake kira iko.
translations.hypothesis: الأسود هما سلالة غزال الأكثر اجتماعية، و هما يعيشون في مجموعات كبيرة تُدعى "مجموعات".

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Garken zaki sun kunshi maza manya daya zuwa uku masu dangantaka, tare da mata da dama har zuwa talatin tare da ‘ya’ya.
translations.hypothesis: غريف (Prides) يتكونن من يان, شون, أو 3 ميراري, بالإضافة إلى 30 أو 40 ماري, و يان.

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Mata yawanci suna da kusanci da juna, kasancewa babban dangi na yan uwa da ƴaƴa mata.
translations.hypothesis: عادةً، البنتان ساروا لا يزالون قريبين، بكونه عائلة كبيرة تتكون من أختان و بنات.

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Taruwar zakuna suna kamar rukunin kyar ko karnuka, dabbobi wanda suka yi kamar da zaki (amma ba sauran manyan kuliyoyi ba) a cikin hali, kuma suna da matukar cutarwa ga abincin su.
translations.hypothesis: غريزة مجموعات أسود تعمل بأسلوب مجموعات ذئاب أو كلاب، وهن كائنات اللاتي سلوكها م相似 مع أسود (ولكن ليس مع سائر الحيوانات الكبيرة)، و هما أيضًا شديدة الخطورة لضحايا.

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Mai gudu sosai, damisa zai iya hawa (amma ba maikyau ba) yi iwo, tsalen nesa sosai da kuma ja so biya kamar kafin mutum.
translations.hypothesis: مؤدي رياضة عالي، النمر ي قادر على الصعود (لكن ليس بشكل مثالي)، السباحة، القفز لمسافات كبيرة، وشد بقوة خمس مرات مقارنة مع قوة إنسان قوي.

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Damisar Tiger tana cikin rukuni guda (Genus Panthera) kamar zakuna, damisar leopards, da jaguars. Wadannan dangin kyanwar guda huɗu sune kaɗai su ke iya ruri.
translations.hypothesis: الأسد سار في نفس الفصيلة (الاسم Panthera) مَع الأسود، الأيل، و الجواح. هؤلاء الأربعة حيوانات هما الوحيدين اللذينสามารถ يصرخون.

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Rurin damisa bai yi kama da cikeke ƙarfin murya zaki ba, amma ya fi kama da gurnani na jimlar kalmomin da aka faɗa da ƙarfi.
translations.hypothesis: الصرخ ذي الفيل لست مثل صرخات قوية، بل مزيج من كلمات غاضبة و صريحة.

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Ƴan wasa suna son cin kananan dabbobi. Za su kama birai, macizai, zazzage da tsuntsaye in sun iya. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da dutsen ya farauto suna ƙasa da shi.
translations.hypothesis: الوكيلوت هاɗɗiyar ɗakiɗaki. Za su ƙoƙarin ɗauɗa ƙwararar, ɗakiɗaki, ƙwararar, kuma ƴan ɗakiɗaki, idan za su iya. Ƙarya na ƴan ɗakiɗaki da الوكيلوت ɗauɗa, sun kasance ƙasa da ƙasa.

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Masana ilimin kimiyya suna tunanin cewa ocelots na bin dabbobi da kama su ta hanyar sansanar sawun inda su ka bi su ka wuce.
translations.hypothesis: العلماء يظنون أن حيوانات "أوكيلوت" يتبعون ويجدون حيوانات ليأكلن (كائنات ليأكلن) من خلال شم، وتحديد أماكن التي كن عليها على الأرض.

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Suna iya gani sosai cikin duhu tare da ganin na dare, kuma suna tafiya cikin sanɗa. Kyanwar daji na farautar abin farautar su ta hanyar sajewa da wurin da su ke sannan su dirar wa abin farautar su.
translations.hypothesis: هالوا يَرى بوضوح cikin ڍاري، و هان يواجي cikin ڍاري. هان يضايق غازالين، ساس ي blended cikin muhimmar, ساس يضايق غازالين.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Yayin da wani karamin gungun dabbobi (jama’a kadan) su ka kasance sun rabu da babban gungun da su ke ciki (misali idan su ka koma kan wasu jerin tsaunuka, ko wani kogi ko kuma su ka koma wani sabon tsibirin yadda ba zasu iya komowa ba) akasari su kan sami kansu a muhalli na daban da inda su ka fito.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Mutane za su kawo hadaya ga abubuwan bauta yayin da malaman bautar za su yi ƙoƙarin biyan buƙatun abubuwan bautar ta hanyar bukukuwa da shagulgula.

translations.source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.reference: Kowane wajen bauta tana da budaden haraba tare da kebantaccen mihrabi wanda limamai kadai ke shiga.
translations.hypothesis: كل معبد كان لديه ساحة مفتوحة، وبعدها، قاعة داخلية, مخصصة فقط للملك.

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Wasu lokuta an gina hasumiya na musamman mai siffar dala, wanda ake kira ziggurats, domin su zama sashi na haikali.
translations.hypothesis: A wani lokaci, "ziggurats" – wani matalanci da ya kama umar – ana gina don su kasanceiswida da tsibbin.

translations.source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.reference: Mata sun yi girki a farfajiyar; shagunan buɗe ido ne kawai suna kallon titi. An yi amfani da dutse don gina gidaje.
translations.hypothesis: المرأة كانوا يطبخوا cikin حیاط; المتاجر كانت مجرد جداول مفتوحة، تنظر إلى الشارع. حجارة كانوا يყენون لإنشاء المنازل.

translations.source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.reference: Babu wani daji mai girma a ƙasar Kan'ana, saboda haka katako yana da tsada.
translations.hypothesis: لم تكن هناك غابات كبيرة في وادي كنعان، ولهذا السبب، خشب كان باهظ الثمن للغاية.

translations.source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.reference: An zauna a Greenland a warwatse. A cikin yankin Norse sun ce an kori Erik the Red daga Iceland saboda kisan kai, kuma lokacin da ya kaɗa ya yi yamma, sai ya gano Greenland kuma ya ba ta suna Greenland.

translations.source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.reference: Amma duk da ganowar sa, dama tuni ƙabilun Eskimo suna zaune a wurin a lokacin.
translations.hypothesis: لكن بغض النظر عن الاكتشاف, قوماً من عرق الإسكيمو كانوا يبيت فيه.

translations.source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.reference: Kodayake kowace ƙasa ta kasance 'Scandinavia', akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutane, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihin Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: با أن كُل ك国 "كان ساڤيجن"، يوجون يوبًا مهار بين مُجتمعات, ملوك, عادات, وتاريخ دانيمارك, سويدن, ناروي, و آيسلاند.

translations.source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.reference: Idan ka kalli majigi mai suna National Treasure, za ka yi tsamanin an rubuta taswirar taska a bayan takardan Ƙudurin ‘Yancin Kai.
translations.hypothesis: إذا قمت بمشاهدة سينيما "National Treasure"، زال يواسيك أن خريطة الكنز ناست على الجهة الخلفية لـ "الإعلان عن الاستقلال".

translations.source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: Sai dai kuma, wannan ba gaskiya ba ne. Duk da cewa akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan daftarin, ba taswirar taskar arziki ba ce.
translations.hypothesis: لكن, wannan بان, لام. لعموم, فيه شيya da كتااب على الجهة الرجوع, amma, لام خريطة كنز.

translations.source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.reference: An rubuta a bayan Bayanin Samun Ƴancin kai kalmomin “Asalin Sanarwar Samun' Yanci ne a ranar 4 ga Yuli 1776”. Rubutun ya bayyana a ƙasan takardar, juye.
translations.hypothesis: "التي كُتبت على الجهة الخلفية لبيان الاستقلال، هما الكلمات "بيان الاستقلال الأصل، وتاريخه هو 4 تموز 1776". النص يظهر في أسفل الوثيقة، ولكن في اتجاه عكسي.

translations.source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.reference: A yayin da babu takamaiman wanda ya rubuta shi, an sani cewa a farkon rayuwar shi, babban takardan (yana daukar ma'aunin inci 29¾ zuwa inci 24½) an nada shi don ajiya.
translations.hypothesis: بينما لا توجد طريقة لتحديد مَن هو مَن يكتبه، يواجهنا اليقين أَن، في بدايات حياته، الوثيقة الكبيرة (التي تقاس 29¾ بوصة بـ 24½ بوصة) تُلصق لغرض التخزين.

translations.source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.reference: Don haka, da alama an ƙara tsarin rubutun ne kawai a matsayin laƙabi.
translations.hypothesis: بنا, يوا س likely wannan kýan yana ƙara kawai kamar wani labarin.

translations.source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.reference: Saukar D-Day da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zuwa sun ƴantar da arewacin Faransa, amma har yanzu kudanci bai sami yanci ba.
translations.hypothesis: الإنزال وعمليات القتال اللاحقة قد أطلقت شمال فرنسا، ولكنه الجزء الجنوبي لا يزال غير حر.
