translations.source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.reference: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta 1940, Kawayen sun mamaye kudancin Faransa, mamayar da aka yi wa lakabi da sunan “Operation Dragoon”.
translations.hypothesis: На 15 авгуست 1940, قوى الائتلاف غازوا النصف الجنوبي لفرانس، wannan غازي "أوبيرېشن دراغون".

translations.source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.reference: A cikin makonni biyu kawai Amurkawa da Sojojin Faransa na ƴancin faransa suka ƴantar da kudancin Faransa kuma suka juya zuwa Jamus.
translations.hypothesis: فقط cikin أسبوعين، القوات الأمريكية و القوات الفرنسية الحرة قد حاصלו أجزاء جغرافية من فرنسا، و هما يوجهون أنظارهم نحو ألمانيا.

translations.source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.reference: Wayewa al’ada ce guda wadda mutane da dama da ke zama da aiki tare na daukan nasu ce, al’umma.
translations.hypothesis: سياست (أو تمدن) هو ثقافة ؤحدة, ؤnde ta kasance ؤnde mutane da yawa sun shafe ؤ kuma suyi aikin tare, ؤnde suke rayu.

translations.source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.reference: Kalmar civilization ta zo ne daga kalmar latin civilis, ma’ana farar hula, mai dangantaka da civis na Latin, ma’ana yan kasa, da cavitas, ma’ana birni ko birnin-jiha, kuma yana ba da adadin yawan jama’a.
translations.hypothesis: الكلمة "سياحة" أتى من الكلمة اللاتينية "سيفيليس"، والتي تعني "سياحي"، ومرتبط مع الكلمة اللاتينية "سيفيس"، والتي تعني "ساكن"، و "سيفيتاس"، والتي تعني "شহর" أو "شহর ذاتي"، و هكذا أيضًا، هى تعرّف حجم المجتمع.

translations.source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.reference: Biranen gari sune kashin bayan al'ummomi. Al'adar wayewar tana nuna wucewar ilimi a cikin tsararraki da yawa, rabe-raben al'adu da rarraba gaskiya.
translations.hypothesis: "المدن المستقلة هما الأساس لبلد. ثقافة حضارية تضمن نقل المعرفة بين أجيال، وجود بصمة ثقافية، ونتشار عادل."

translations.source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.reference: kananun al’adu galibi su kan shuɗe ba tare da barin tabbatattun shaidu na tarihi ba kuma ba a saka su cikin jerin manyan zamunna.
translations.hypothesis: الأدوار الثقافية الصغيرة، يواجهن مشكلة اختفاء دون ترك أي دليل تاريخي ذي أهمية، و هكذا لا يُعترف بهن كحضارات حقيقية.

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: A lokacin Yaƙin Juyin Juya Hali, jihohi goma sha ukun sun kafa gwamnatin tsakiya mai rauni - wadda ta kunshi Majalisa kawai - a ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnatin hadin gwiwa.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin harbulin, cikin 13 gwamatin, za su fara shirin golema kwamitin gwamnati – inda kwamitin gwamnati ne kawai – ta hanyar Dokokin Golema.

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.reference: Majalisa ba ta da wani iko na kakaba haraji, sannan kuma, kasancewar babu ɓangarorin zartaswa da na shari’a na ƙasar, ta dogara ne kan hukumomin jihohi, waɗanda mafi yawanci ba sa bayar da haɗin kai, wajen ganin an tilasta aiki da dokokin.
translations.hypothesis: مجلس لا يمتلك أي سلطة لفرض الضرائب، و، لعدم وجود حكومة أو قضاء على مستوى الوطنية، هو اعتمد على سلطات الولايات، اللاتي غالبًا ما لا تتعاون، لإنفاذ جميع أعماله.

translations.source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.reference: Hakanan ba ta da ikon yin watsi da dokokin haraji da haraji tsakanin jihohi.
translations.hypothesis: ضار, لاء يمتلك سلطة لالغاء قانون ضريبة و التعريفات بين الولايات.

translations.source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.reference: Labaran sun buƙaci yarjejeniya baki ɗaya daga dukkan jihohin kafin a iya gyara su kuma jihohi sun ɗauki gwamnatin tarraya a sauƙaƙe cewa wakilansu ba su nan.
translations.hypothesis: القرارات ناوية إجماع من كلاً من الولايات قبل أن يُعدَّلوا، و الولايات تعاملت مع الحكومة المركزية بلامبالاة، حتئ ممثליהم غالبًا ما كانوا غائبين.

translations.source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.reference: Masu kwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Italiya, tare da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Jamus ita ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya kuma sun kasance zakarun ƙwallon ƙafa na FIFA a 2006.
translations.hypothesis: كُلاب الساحرة الإيطالية، شاوكي مع الفريق القومي الألماني، هما ثاني كُلاب الأكثر نجاح في العالم، و هما بطلون في بطولة العالم لفيفا عام 2006.

translations.source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Shahararrun wasanni sun hada da kwallon kafa, kwallon kwando, wasan kwallon raga, wasan ruwa, wasan takobi, wasan kwallon rugby, tseren kekuna, kwallon gora, wasan kwallon gorar kankara da na tseren motoci na F1.
translations.hypothesis: الرياضات المشهورة شاملة: ة फुटबल، باسكټبال، فوليت، ة، فنس، روجبي، تايل، هوكي عالي، هوكي عجل، و سباق سيارات F1.

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Wasannin hunturu sun shahara a yankuna na Arewa, inda da Italiyawa su ke fafatawa a wasannin kasa da kasa da wasannin Olympic.
translations.hypothesis: الرياضات الشتوية هما الأكثر شهرة في المناطق الشمالية، حيث أن الإيطاليين يشاركوا في مباريات دولية وأحداث أولمبية.

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: Japans suna riƙe da kusan tsibirai 7,000 (babba shine Honshu), yana mai sanya Japan tsibiri na 7 mafi girma a duniya!
translations.hypothesis: الياهن يمتلكون כמעט 7,000 جزيرة (بينها الجزيرة الأكبر وهي هونشو)، وهذا يجعله الجزيرة رقم 7 الأكبر في العالم!

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: Saboda tari/rukunin tsibirai da Japan ke da su, sau da yawa akan kira Japan, a matsayin yanki, da suna “tarin tsibirai”.
translations.hypothesis: بسبب وجود مجموع/مجموعة جزر، اليابان يُمثل، من وجهة جغرافي، كـ "مجموعة جزر".

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Farkon Taiwan ya faro tun baya cikin karni na 15 inda Turawa matukan jirgin ruwa da ke wucewa suka ɗauki sunan tsibirin a matsayin IIha Formosa, ko kyakyawan tsibiri.
translations.hypothesis: تايوان، مهارها تانا cikin shekarun 15, nde masu sayar da lafiya daga Ewropa, wanda ke taya, sun sanya suna "Ilha Formosa" ko "Ilha mai kyau".

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: A cikin 1624, Kamfanin Dutch East India Company ya kafa tushe a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, yana ƙaddamar da canji a cikin ayyukan noman hatsi na asali da ɗaukar ma'aikata na China don yin aiki a gonakin shinkafa da sukari.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1624, "Dutch East India Company" ta kawo wata ƙasa a arewa maso gabashin Taiwan, wanda ya haifar da canji a yanayi na samar da kayu na asali, kuma ta amfani da ma'aikata daga China don aiki a farin da suka yi, kamar farin da suka yi.

translations.source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1683, sojojin daular Qing (1644-1912) sun kwace ikon lardin Taiwan na yammacin da arewacin gabar teku, suka ayyana Taiwan a matsayin lardin daular Qing a shekarar 1885.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1683, ملوك سْوين (1644-1912) يسيطرون على الأجزاء الغربية وشمالية الساحل، وعلنوا أن تايوان هي مقاطعة من إمبراطورية سْوين عام 1885.

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1895, bayan kayarwa a cikin Farkon Yaƙin Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), gwamnatin Qing su sa-hannu a Yarjejeniyar Shimonoseki, ta wanda ta bayar da mulkin kan Taiwan zuwa ga Japan, wanda ya yi mulkin tsibirin har 1945.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1895, bayan sakinsa a cikin Yaƙin Sino-Japan (1894-1895), ҳуку lana Qing sun imar da Shartul Shimonoseki, wanda ya bada suwo suwa Japan, wanda ke mulki kan wannan ƙasa har zuwa 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu ya hada da tsari uku, masu suna Intihuatana, Temple of the Sun, da Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu تتكون من غرف نا, بيت الشمس, و غرف ذو الأبواب, وهن هما الهياكل الأساسية.

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.reference: An sake gina mafi yawan gine-ginen da ke gefen rukunin ginin domin ƴan yawon buɗe ido su fahimci yadda asalin siffarsu ta ke.
translations.hypothesis: غالب أغلب دارan da ke a kusa da wannan kompleks, sun fara sabu sabu domin yin shiri da masu zamanta, domin su sami fahimma ta kyau game da yadda su ke a farkon.

translations.source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.reference: Zuwa shekarar 1976, an farfado da kashi talatin na gine ginen Machu Picchu kuma har yanzu ana ci gaba da aikin.
translations.hypothesis: حتى عام 1976, 30% من Machu Picchu قد تم ترميم, kuma wannan مهارة تستم حتى сада.

translations.source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.reference: A misali, nau’in hoto marar motsi da aka fi sani a duniya shi ne 35mm, wanda shi ne girman fim na hoto da aka fi amfani da shi a ƙarshen zamanin fim ɗin hannu.
translations.hypothesis: عن سبيل، النسخة شائعة وروحي ل تصوير صبور (still image)  في העולם هي 35mm، وهي حجم الفيلم البارز  في نهاية عصره.

translations.source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: Har yau din nan ana sarrafa shi, amma muhimmin abu a nan kyamarar komi da ruwanka ce ta gaje shi da ke sunsuno hotuna.
translations.hypothesis: رغم ذلك، لا يزال يُنتج حتى اليوم، ولكن الأهم من ذلك، هو أن تنسيق صوره قد ورثه تنسيقات المستشعرات (sensors) لآلات التصوير الرقمي.

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Abin mamaki shine zubin 35mm a haƙiƙa fadin 36mm ya ke da shi da kuma tsawon 24mm.
translations.hypothesis: الأحجام 35mm، بحدقيق, هما 36 ملم في العرض و 24 ملم في الارتفاع، وهي مهار.

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: A lissafin wannan tsarin (idan aka raba sha biyu domin samun adadi mafi karancin lamba) zai kasance a daidaiton 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: النسبة بين عرض وارتفاع wannan تنسيق (عن طريق قسيمه برقم 12 ليحصل على النسبة البسيطة)، إذن يُقَال أنها 3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Yawancin hanyoyin gama gari na yau da kullun (misali tsarin APS na iyali) ya kusa da wannan tsari.
translations.hypothesis: أشكال شائعة (مثل عائلة APS)، هما ساوى أو قريبي لنسبة هذي.

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Dokar da aka fi rainawa itace dokar gina dynamism tare da tabbatar da tsarin a hoto.
translations.hypothesis: القاعدة "ثُلاثة أجزاء" (rule of thirds) wanda عامةً يُساء استخدامه و يُستهزأ به، هي إرشادات البسيطة، وتساعد على إضفاء حيوية، مع الحفاظ على ترتيب في صورة.

translations.source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.reference: Ya bayyana cewa wuri mafi mahimmanci a darasin shine mahadar layuka wanda ya raba hoton a tsaye da kuma a kwance (duba misali).
translations.hypothesis: ذال يوضح أن الأفضل لتقويم البابن هو في نقطة تلاقي الخطوط اللاتي قسّم الصورة إلى ثلاثة أجزاء عموديًا و أفقيًا (انظر المثال).

translations.source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.reference: A wannan lokaci na tarihin Tarayyan Turai, cocin Katolika, wadda ta yi ƙarfi da arziki, ta fuskanci bincike.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin wannan zaman tarihi na ევropa, الكاثوليك، اللاتي كسبن ثروة و قوت، كوشاوه.

translations.source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.reference: Sama da shekara dubu addinin Kirista ya haɗe kasashen Turai waje guda duk da banbance banbance na harsuna da ala’adu.
translations.hypothesis: غازات يوروبي، تابات, لا يزالون متحدين لقرون, وتجاوز ألف، على الرغم من اختلاف اللغات وعادات.

translations.source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.reference: Ƙarfin barnansa ta shafe kowa daga sarki har na gama-gari.
translations.hypothesis: القوة التي تغلغل في كل مكان أثرت على كبار و صغار.

translations.source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin shishikan addinin krista shine yin amfani da arziki wajen magance matsaloli da kuma yakar talauci sannan kuma jami’in kudi na cocin suna can musamman saboda wannan dalilin.
translations.hypothesis: فكرة ؤnde ؤnde ta ƙasa, shine cewa ɗaukan kaya ɗaya ya kamata ya kasance don taimakawa ؤ kuma ganowa, kuma kuma ɗaukan maka na ƙasihu, ana amfani da shi don wannan burin.

translations.source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.reference: Babban cibiyar shugabancin coci ta kasance a Roma sama da dubban shekaru kuma mayar da arziki da mulki can ya jawo cece-kuce game da ko ana bin wannan shikashikin.
translations.hypothesis: السلطة المركزية للكنيسة تقع في روما لأكثر من ألف عام، وتركيز هذا النوع من القوة والموارد قد دفع العديد إلى التساؤل عما إذا كان هذا المبدأ يتم تنفيذه.

translations.source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.reference: Jim kaɗan bayan ɓarkewar tashin hankalin, Birtaniya ta fara toshe mashigan ruwa na Jamus.
translations.hypothesis: حوالي بعد مطلع仗, مملكة بريطانيا قد بدأت حصار بحري لجيرمان.

translations.source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: Dabarun sun yi tasiri, hana shigar da muhimman kayayyakin soja da na farar hulla, ko da yake wannan toshewa ta sabawa dokoki na ƙasa da ƙasa waɗanda yarjejeniyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama na ƙarnoni biyu da suka wuce suka tsara.
translations.hypothesis: الاستراتيجية نالت نجاح, بقطع خطوط إمداد عسكرية و مدنية, على الرغم من أن هذا الحصار, يواجه قوانين دولية المعتمدة, اللاتي سُلّمت من خلال عدة ميثاق دولي في العقود الأخيرين.

translations.source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.reference: Birtaniya ta dasa bama bamai a teku domin hana jiragen ruwa shiga wannan yanki na teku, abinda ke da hadari ga jiragen yan baruwanmu.
translations.hypothesis: بريطانيا قد استخدمت غواصات لغزو مياه دولية, وذلك لمنع أي سفينة من الدخول إلى أي قسم من المحيط, مما قد يسبب خطر حتى لـ سفن محايدة.

translations.source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.reference: Tunda aka samu karancin sakamako ga wannan dabarun, Jamus tayi tsammanin sakamako irin haka zuwa ga yakin kasan tekun da bashi da kayyadewa.
translations.hypothesis: بينما كان رد فعل ضئيل على wannan טكتيك, ألمانيا تتوقع رد فعل موازٍ لعمليات غواصيها غير المقيدة.

translations.source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.reference: A lokacin 1920s, halaye mafi rinjaye na yawancin ƴan ƙasa da ƙasashe shine na zaman lafiya da keɓewa.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1920, הגישה הراجعة لغالبية المواطنين ودول هي גישה تهدف إلى الهدوء و العزلة.

translations.source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.reference: Bayan ganin munanan abubuwa da munanan yaƙe-yaƙe yayin Yaƙin Duniya na ɗaya, al'ummomi sun so su guje wa irin wannan yanayin a nan gaba.
translations.hypothesis: بعد مشاهدة فظائع و أعمال وحشية رأت في الحرب العالمية الأولى، القوم أرادوا تجنب هكذا وضع مرة أخرى في المستقبل.

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: A cikin 1884, Tesla ya koma Amurka don karɓar aiki tare da Kamfanin Edison a cikin New York City.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1884, Tesla ya tafi kasar Amurika don ritaya a cikin kamfanin Edison a birnin New York.

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Ya iso Amurka da sulai 4 kacal, da wani littafin wakoki, da wasikar gabatarwa daga Charles Batchelor (manajansa a aikin da ya bari) zuwa ga Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: ووه لاحق إلى Америка، دارن 4 سنت، كِتاب شعر، و رسالة توصية من تشارلز باتشول (سيديه سابق) إلى توماس إديسون.

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: Ƙasar China ta zamanin da tana da wata hanyar musamman ta nuna lokutan yanayi daban-daban; kowane mataki na China ko kowane iyali da ya hau karagar mulki to shi ma daula ce ta daban.
translations.hypothesis: China ta wadata da hanya ɗaya don sanar da lokutan ɗabi'i; duk matakan China ko duk alama da ke mulki, wannan duk alama ɗaya ne.

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Haka nan tsakanin kowace daula a kan sami lokaci na rashin zaman lafiya tsakanin larduna. Fitacce daga waɗannan zamuna shi ne zamanin Masarautu Uku da ya faru tsawon shekaru 60 tsakanin Daular Han da ta Jin.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك, ما بين كل سلالة, كان مهد فترة عدم استقرار, مَع وجود ولايات متباعدة. مهد الأكثر شهرة, هو عصره "ثلاث ممالك", الذي دام 60 عام, بين سلالة هان و سلالة جين.

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: A wancan lokaci yaki ya barke tsakanin mafi yawan gidajen sarauta da ke hankoron kujerar sarki.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin wannan zaman, لاهار ضار وعمل جار ما بين العديد من الأفراد, اللai كانوا يخاصمون لغاية الحصول على العرش.

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: Masarauta Uku ya kasance daya daga cikin zamunan da aka fi zub da jini a tarihin Tsohuwar China dubban mutane sun mutu suna gwagwarmaya don zama a kan madaukakiyar kujera a babbar fada a Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: "Wannan zaman, wanda ana ke kira "Watsan Hausa," هو أحد الأكثر دمار في التاريخ القديم لجمهورية الصين، حيث ما لا يقل عن آلاف رعايا قُتلوا في معارك ليحصلوا على منصب الأهم في القصر العظيم في شيان.

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Akwai tasiri na zamantakewa da siyasa masu yawa kamar amfani da tsarin awo cikakke, barin kama-karya zuwa jamhuriyya, kishin ƙasa tare da imanin cewa ƙasar ta mutanen ƙasa ce ba mutum ɗaya mai mulki ba.
translations.hypothesis: هناك آثار كثرة, شوهي و سياسية, kamar amfani da نظام المتر, يَرجي من نظام المطلق إلى نظام جمهوري, القومية, و الاعتقاد أن البلد يخص الشعب, لا شخص واحد.

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Hakanan bayan juyin halin an bude ayyuka ga duk maza masu neman aiki inda hakan ya bada dama ga masu buri da kokari su sami cigaba.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، بعد الثورة، فرص التدريب وظيفي تتاح لجميع المتقدمين، مما يُمكّن الأكثر طموحًا ونجاحًا من تحقيق أهدافهم.

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Hakanan ya kasance ga sojoji saboda maimakon martaba sojoji ya kasance bisa la'akari da aji sai yanzu suka dogara da cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: هذا متبادل لجيش, saboda ba'ai ba, رتبة عسكرية لا تعتمد على تصنيف, بل الآن تعتمد على مهارة.

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: Muhammadu yana matukar sha'awar al'amuran da suka wuce rayuwar wannan duniya. Ya na yawan ziyarar kogon da a ka fi sani da na “Hira” a tsaunin “Noor” (wato haske) domin kadaicewa yayi tunani.
translations.hypothesis: محمود كان لديه اهتمام عظيم بقضايا تتجاوز هذه الحياة العادية. كان يرتاد كهف، الذي أصبح معروفًا باسم "هيرا"، على جبل "نور" (نور)، ليقوم بالتأمل.

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: ya ɓoye kansa, wanda ya rayu a lokacin, yana ba da hoton karkatawar ruhaniyar Muhammad a tsarari.
translations.hypothesis: النفق بحد ذاته, wanda ya tsira daga lokutan, yana bayar da wani hoton da yake da ƙarfi game da sha'awun ruhani na Muhammad.

translations.source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Kasancewa a saman ɗayan duwatsun arewacin Makka, kogon ya zama ya keɓe daga sauran duniya.
translations.hypothesis: غار yana cikin saman salah daya daga cikin madafun da ke kusa da Mecca, kuma yana cikin izala daga dukkanin dunia.

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: A hakika akwai matukar wahalar gano wajen ko ma ka idan ka san ya kasance. Kana shiga cikin kogon zaka ji kadaita ta kama ka.

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: Babu abin da za a iya gani face kyakkyawan sararin samaniya da tsaunuka masu yawa da ke kewayen. Baka iya ji ko ganin wadannan daga cikin kogon.
translations.hypothesis: لا يُمْكِن رؤية أي شىء سواه، سماء ياو و جبال النواحي. لا يُمْكِن رؤية أو سما أي شىء من wannan duniyar daga cikin cikin.

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: Babban alwatikan a Giza shine kawai ɗayan abubuwan al'ajabi bakwai da har yanzu suke tsaye a yau.
translations.hypothesis: "البيرايد العظيم بجيزا هو الـ واحد ؤمن السبع عجائب ؤ لاء لا يزال قائما حتى اليوم.

translations.source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Babban Masarautar da Masarawa suka gina a ƙarni na uku KZ, Babban alwatika yana ɗayan manyan gine-ginen dala da aka gina don girmama Fir'auna da ya mutu.
translations.hypothesis: "البيرايد العظيم، wanda an gina ta daga masu zaman gaskiya a shekara ta 300 ق.م، هو مهاردا daga manyan biya da an gina don irdi da Firawa da ya kashe.

translations.source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.reference: Giza Plateau, ko “Giza Necropolls” a Kwarin Massar na matattu yana kunshe da dala iri-iri ( wanda babban dala shine mafi girma), yawancin kananan kaburbura, gidajen bauta, da babban gunkin Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: المنطقة "جيزا"، و المعروفة "موقع الجنائز" في وادي الموت في مصر، تحتوي على كثرة الأهرامات (حيث أن الأهرام العظيم هو الأكبر)، كثرة القبور الصغيرة، كثرة المعابد، و الأهرام العظيم.

translations.source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.reference: Babbar dalar an kafa ta ne domin girmama Fir’auna Khufu, kuma da daman cikinsu da kushewu da wuraren ibada an gina su ne domin matan Khufu tare da iyalan gidansa.
translations.hypothesis: البييراميد الضخم نا' muka yi don ىيɗɗa الفراعون خوفو، kuma manyan biyeramida, makaburi, da tsibbin, na' muka yi don ىيɗɗa عورات خوفو da membobin wannan.

translations.source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.reference: Alamar “kwarin sama” ta yi kama da V sannan “alamar kwarin ƙasa” kamar maɗauri ne ko murabba’i da ya kuskure gefen ƙasan ta.
translations.hypothesis: "Markin 'up bow' kamar wannan, kuma "markin 'down bow' kamar wannan, wanda yana kamar ƙasa ko ƙasa da ƙasa.

translations.source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.

translations.source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.reference: Yawancin lokoci up-bow na fitar da murya mai laushi, haka kuma down-bow na da ƙarfi da tabatarwa sosai.
translations.hypothesis: "الـ"أبو" (up-bow) عادةً ما يُنشئ صوت ناعم، بينما الـ"أبو" (down-bow) قوى وأكثر وضوح.

translations.source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.reference: Ka saki jikinka wajen bada naka makin, amma kar ka manta makin da aka buga su na da dalilai na kida, don haka ya kamata a girmama su.
translations.hypothesis: لالا, زاؤ يوصل أن تضع علامات ضو, amma تذكّر, أن العلامات المطبوعة هما لغرض مزيكا, لانو زاؤ يبغي أن ي respect.

translations.source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.reference: A firgice Sarki Louis da Sarauniya Marie Antoinette da yayansu guda biyu (Marie yar shekaru 11 da kuma Louis-Charles dan shekara hudu) da kuma yar'uwar Sarki, Madam Elizabeth, wadanda matan kasuwa masu bore a ranar 6 ga watan Oktoba 1789 sun tilasta musu komawa birnin Faris daga garin Versailles.
translations.hypothesis: الملك لويس السادس عشر، الملكة ماري أنطوانيت، وطفليهم (ماريه تيريز البالغة من العمر 11 عامًا ولويس-شارل البالغ من العمر أربع سنوات)، و أخت الملكة، السيدة إليزابيث، في 6 أكتوبر 1789، وُجِבוَ مرة أخرى إلى باريس من فيرسيليس، وذلك بسبب حشد من باهال.

translations.source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.reference: A cikin tarago, suka koma zuwa Paris zagaye da wasu gungun mutane da ke ihu suna kalaman barazanar a kan Sarki da Sarauniya.
translations.hypothesis: فِي سيارة, ساروا يواجهون عاصفة ريح من الناس, ساءلين و يصرخون تهديدات ض gegen الملك و الملكة.

translations.source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.reference: Tarin mutanen ya tilastawa sarkin da sarauniyar bude tagogin abun hawan nasu.

translations.source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.reference: A wata lokaci memba na yan zanga-zanga shugaban wata sarauta tsarewa sun kashe wata Versailles a gaban Sarauniya mai firgita.
translations.hypothesis: في مرحلة ما، سياف من بين الجموع قام بإظهار رأس حارس ملكي وُجِد في فيرسائيلي, أمام الملكة التي كانت خائفة.

translations.source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.reference: Kuɗaɗen ɗaukar nauyin yaƙi na mulkin mallakar Amurka a yakin mallake Philippines mutanen Phillippines ne da kansu suka biya.
translations.hypothesis: أحاسيس仗 التي استخدمتها الإمبراطورية الأمريكية في غزو الفلبين، تم تمويلها من قبل الشعب الفلبيني.

translations.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.reference: An tilasta musu su biya haraji ga gwamnatin mulkin mallaka ta Amurka don biyan wani babban kaso na kudaden da aka kashe da kuma kuɗin-ruwa na kan basukan da aka fitar da sunan gwamnatin Philippines ta cikin bankunan Wall Street.
translations.hypothesis: كانوا ملزمين دفع الجزية إلى النظام الاستعماري الأمريكي، وذلك لتغطية حصة كبيرة من النفقات، وكذلك الفائدة على السندات التي تم إصدارها باسم حكومة الفلبين، من خلال بنوك Wall Street.

translations.source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.reference: Tabbas, babban ribar da aka samu daga kwarar da aka dade ana yi wa ‘yan Filifins ya zama shi ne tushen nasarar mallakar bayan yanci da Amurka ta samu.
translations.hypothesis: البشكل، الأرباح الضخمة اللاتي يُحصل عليها من استغلال المطول للشعب الفيلipino، ستكون الأساسية لسياسات الإمبريالية الأمريكية.

translations.source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.reference: Don fahimtar Templars dole ne mutum ya fahimci mahallin da ya haifar da ƙirƙirar tsari.
translations.hypothesis: Domin fahamu Templars, لزوم fahamu mahallin da ya sa wannan ƙungiyar ta wanzu.

translations.source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: Zamanin da al'amuran suka faru galibi ana masu lakabi da Mafi girmn Shekarun Tsakiya lokacin tarihin Turai a ƙarni na 11, 12, da 13th (AD 1000 - 1300).
translations.hypothesis: القرن الذي رُتب فيها الأحداث، يشار إليه عادةً باسم "القرون الوسطى العالية"، وهي فترة عهد في التاريخ الأوروبي، في القرون الحادي عشر، الثاني عشر، والثالث عشر (بين عامي 1000 و 1300).

translations.source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.reference: Lokacin karni na tsakiya na sama yana rigaye ne lokacin karni na tsakiya da ya zo kafin shi sannan yana tafe ne lokacin karni na tsakiya da yazo daga can gaba, wanda ya kamata ace ya kare a  daidai shekarar1500.
translations.hypothesis: القرون الوسطى، بصفة عامة، تسبقها القرون الوسطى المبكرة، وتليها القرون الوسطى اللاحقة، اللاتي، وفقًا للتقاليد، يختتمن حوالي عام 1500.

translations.source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.reference: Wanzuwar Fasahar Ƙere-ƙere al’amari ne da ya haɗo wani faffaɗan fage na ra’ayoyi a aikace, daga bunƙasar fasaha ko muhimmancin fasahar ƙere-ƙere zuwa ga haƙiƙanin sanin cewa makomar dan adam tana tafiya ne bisa tabbatacciyar hikima wadda ke da alaƙa da dokokin kimiyya da kuma bayyanar su a cikin fasahar ƙere-ƙere.
translations.hypothesis: "Determinism ؤيا" هو مصطلح wanda ya kasar da manyan ra'ayoyi, daga "سون ؤيا" ko "حاجة ؤيا" zuwa wani ؤر, wanda ya nuna cewa kalmomin ؤيا sun kasance ne daga wani ؤر wanda ya shiri da dokokin ilimi da yadda su yawo a ؤيا.

translations.source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.reference: Yawancin fassarar tabbatuwar fasahar zamani sun kunshi ra’ayi mafiya yaduwa guda biyu: cewa na fasaha ita kanta na bin tafarki wacce ta sha bamban da tasirin al’ada ko siyasa da kuma cewa fasaha nada “tasiri” ga al’umma masu asali, fiye da na tsarin yanayin zamantakewa.
translations.hypothesis: غالب أغلب تفسيرات "تحديد تكنولوجي" يمتلكون فكرتان عظيم: أن تطور التكنولوجيا بحد ذاتها يتبع مسار الذي لا يتأثر بشكل كبيراً بالعادات أو السياسات، و أن التكنولوجيا بدورها "تؤثر" على المجتمعات بطريقة جوهرية، بدلاً من أن تكون نتيجة للتأثيرات الاجتماعية.

translations.source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.reference: Misali, mutum na iya cewa motar tilas ba zata haifar da ci gaban hanyoyi ba.
translations.hypothesis: على سبيل المثال، س person ba za iya cewa, "سيارة motorized حتماً يساغ cikin ɓirar."

translations.source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.reference: Koyaya, hanyar sadarwa ta ƙasa gabaɗaya ba ta da tasirin tattalin arziƙi don ƙarancin motoci, saboda haka ana ƙirƙirar sabbin hanyoyin samarwa don rage farashin mallakar mota.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، شبكة طرق بجميع أنحاء البلد ليست ميسورة من الناحية الاقتصادية لعدد قليل فقط من سيارات، لذلك يتم تطوير طرق جديدة لإنتاج السيارات بهدف تقليل تكلفة امتلاكها.

translations.source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.reference: Hakanan mallakar motoci da yawa yana haifar da yawan hadari a kan hanyoyi, wanda ke haifar da kirkirar sabbin dabaru a fannin kiwon lafiya don gyaran jikin da ya lalace.
translations.hypothesis: زيادة في يوبنารถยนต์, يساهم أيضًا في حدوث حوادث على الطرق, wannan يساهم في ابتكار تقنيات جديدة في الرعاية الصحية لإصلاح الأجسام المتضررة.

translations.source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.reference: Tsarin fasaha da adabi samar da al’adu, wanda marubuta irinsu Gothe, Fichte da Schlegel su ka samar.

translations.source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda aka san Paris da babban birnin salon zamani na duniyar yau, ana ɗaukar Constantinople a matsayin babban birni na zamani na Turai.
translations.hypothesis: بمطريقة التي باريس تُعرّف كعاصمة الموضة للعالم المعاصر، كانت القسطنطينية تُعتبر عاصمة الموضة لغرب يوروب.

translations.source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Shaharar ta na kasancewa cibiyar jin daɗi ya fara ne a kusan shekara ta 400 A.D. kuma ya kai har kusan 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: الشهرة ta wadata a kan zama wani wuri na ƙasa, ta fara ne kwanan nan, wanda ta ciya har zuwa shekara ta 1100.

translations.source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.reference: Matsayinta ya yi kasa a ƙarni na goma sha biyu musamman sakamakon dawowar mayakan jihadin kuros dauke da kyaututtuka irin su siliki da kayan ɗanɗanon abinci waɗanda ake ɗauka da daraja fiye da abubuwan da ake sayarwa a kasuwannin Daular Rum.
translations.hypothesis: مقامها يان, عام ألف وأربعمائة, يان, لاسيما بسبب حقيقة أن "الكروسيدرز" (Crusaders) كانوا يرتدوا مع هدايا, kamar قماش و توابل, اللاتي كان قيمتها تزيد عن تلك التي توفرها أسواق "بيزنطي".

translations.source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.reference: A wannan lokacin ne sauya mukamin na Kawar Babban Birni daga Constantinople zuwa Paris ya faru.

translations.source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.reference: Tsarin Gothic ya yi shura a tsakankanin karni na 10 zuwa na 11 da kuma karni na 14.
translations.hypothesis: النمط الغوتيك كان في ذروته في الفترة ما بين القرون العاشرة - الحادي عشر، و القرن الرابع عشر.

translations.source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.reference: A farkon lamari, kabilar Byzantine da ke gabashi ta karfafa saka tufafi.
translations.hypothesis: A farkon ƙofa, ƙa'aƙan ta ta shiri da ƙalmar Byzantine a kusa.

translations.source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.reference: Koyaya, saboda saurin tashoshin sadarwa, salo a yamma na iya zama baya zuwa shekara 25 zuwa 30.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، بسبب بطء وسائط تواصل، الأساليب الموجودة في الغرب قد يتأخر بها 25 إلى 30 عام.

translations.source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.reference: a karshen karnin tsakiya sashin nahiyar turai na yamma ta fara bunkasa nata tsarin. Daya daga cikin abubuwan da aka gina a wannan lokacin da taimakon ‘yan jihadi shine fara amfani da anini don rike riga.
translations.hypothesis: Nasa ƙarshen shekara na tsawon zaman, Ewropuwa ta Kasa ta fara ƙirƙirar ƙirar ta. Ɗaya daga cikin sabbin abubuwa na wannan zaman, a matsu da "حملات", mutane suka fara amfani da "أزرار" don jin ƙara tufannan.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.reference: Noma domin abinci shine tsarin noma wanda ake yinsa domin kawai a samar da abincin da zai wadatar da mutum da iyalansa.
translations.hypothesis: "البحارة زراعة, هي نوع زراعة الذي يُقام لإنتاج طعام كافي ليغطي الاحتياجات البسيطة للمزارع و عائلته."

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.reference: Noma domin abinci kawai abu ne mai sauki, sau da yawa, ana amfani da iri na shuka wanda ya dace da kasar noman wajen, tare da sauya abin shuka duk shekara a gona guda, domin samun cikakkiyar yabanya.
translations.hypothesis: "الزراعة барои غايات, هي نظام البسيط, شايعاً طبيعي, wanda ya ƙayyashi, سمن da ya kasance a cikin wannan yankin, tare da sabon ƙimiya, ko kuma sauran hanyoyin da za su iya ƙarfafa sana'a.

translations.source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.reference: A tarihance mafi yawan manoma sun kasance suna aikin noma kuma wannan har yanzu haka lamarin yake a yawancin ƙasashe masu tasowa.
translations.hypothesis: عبر التاريخ, أغلب مزارعين كانوا يمارцу субаستенس, و wannan يظل هالك في كثرة أوطان ناembangkan.

translations.source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.reference: Rassan al’adu suna sada mutane masu tunani iri daya da suke ji tsarin rayuwa na al’umma bai dace da su ba inda suke ba su damar ganin suna da muhimanci a al’umma.
translations.hypothesis: غروپ-غروپ (subcultures) ياجين masu sha'awa, wanda suka kasance da ayyuka, kuma sun gida cewa sun kasance cikin ƙaƙƙara daga ƙimar jama'a, kuma suna ba su damar ƙiyaye ɗayan.

translations.source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Ana iya bambanta kananan al’adu saboda shekara, bangarenci na jama’a, matsayi cikin al’umma, guri, da/ko kuma jintsin membobi.
translations.hypothesis: غروپ-غروپ (subcultures) نukan da ƙirar, ƙabila, ƙasa, wurin, kuma/ko jinsi na mutanen da ke a cikin su.

translations.source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.reference: Kyawawan siffofin da suke tabbatar da wata ƙaramar al’ada a matsayin wadda ta fita daban kan iya kasancewa na yare, kyau, addini, siyasa, jinsi, na yanki, ko hadin abubuwa.
translations.hypothesis: الخصائص اللاتي تحدد ثقافة فرعية بوضوح، قد تكون لغوية، جمالية، دينية، سياسية، جنسية، جغرافية، أو مزيج من العوامل.

translations.source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.reference: Membobin masana'antar sau da yawa suna nuna alamar kasancewa memba ta hanyar rarrabe mai amfani da alama ta salon, wanda ya haɗa da salon, halayen kirki, da ɗaukar hoto.
translations.hypothesis: أعضاء تكتل ثقافة غالبًا ما يُظهرون عضويتهم من خلال استخدام نمط متميز ورمزي، وذا يشمل الأزياء، السلوك، ولهجات.

translations.source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin matakan da ake amfani dashi domin nuna muhimmacin zamantakewa shine nuna kadan daga cikin hali na takaici wanda yara suka fuskanta, ta hanyar sakaci, masifa, ko cin zarafi, kuma basu zamantakewa da manya ba yayin da suke girma.

translations.source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.reference: Ana kiran irin waɗannan yaran “sakakku” ko masu wuyar juyawa. Mutane sun sha kulle waɗansu sakakkun yara (yawanci iyayensu ne); a wasu al’amuran kuma barin yaran na da alaƙa da ƙin amincewar iyaye da naƙasar basira ko ta jikin yaro.
translations.hypothesis: الأطفال הלذين هكذا يُسما "بأطفال بري" أو "بأطفال غير مُربي". بضعة أطفال بري، هُؤُجられました (عادةً من قِبَل والديَهُم); في بَعْض الحالات، هَذَا التخلي عن الطفل كان ناتجًا عن رفض الوالدين لعيوب عقليَّة أو جسديَّة قوية لدى الطفل.

translations.source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.reference: Yaran mara zuciya masu jin tsoro na iya fuskantar mummunan cin zarafin yara ko rauni kafin a watsar da su ko su gudu.
translations.hypothesis: الطفال ذوي السلوك غير طبيعي, قد يواجهوا سوء معاملة أو صدمة كبيرة قبل أن يتم تركه أو الهروب.

translations.source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.reference: Wasu ana zargin dabbobi ne suka yi rainon su; an ce wasu sun yi rayuwa a daji da kansu.
translations.hypothesis: Ба su ne, ana ce suna rayuwa da wani, wasu ana ce suna rayuwa cikin ƙasa da kansu.

translations.source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.reference: Idan ya kasance dabbar da ba mutum bace ta raini yaro gaba daya, zai kasance yaro zai taso da (na zihiri) kusan duka irin suffar dabi'un dabbar da ta kula dashi,misali irin yadda yake tsoro da rashin ko-in kula ga sauran mutane.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da ɗauwar yana cikin رعاية حيوانات غير بشرية، ɗauwar ɓarna يظهر سلوك (حسب القدرات الجسدية) المشابه جدًا لسلوك الحيوان الذي رعاها، مثل خوفه أو عدم اهتمامه بالإنسان.

translations.source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.reference: Duk da yake tushen koyo game da aiki yakamata ya sauƙaƙa ilmantarwa kuma ya zama mai ban sha'awa, ƙwanƙwasa aiki ya wuce mataki.
translations.hypothesis: بينما مهارات למידה, يجب أن تجعل למידה أسهل وأكثر إثارة، لكن "بناء" يذهب إلى مستوى أبعد.

translations.source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.reference: Nannadewa ba hanya ce ta ilmantarwa ba amma taimako ne wanda ke bayar da tallafi ga mutanen da ke fuskantar sabon ƙwarewar ilmantarwa kamar amfani da sabon shirin komputa ko fara sabon aiki.
translations.hypothesis: "Scaffolding אינו ميثاق تعلم، بل هو وسيلة تزويد الأفراد, اللذين يمرون بتجربة تعلم جديدة, مثل استخدام برنامج جهاز الحاسوب الجديد أو بدء مشروع جديد, مع الدعم."

translations.source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Scafflods zasu iya zama na gaske da kuma virtual, a wasu kalaman, malami wani bangare ne na scafflod amma hakanan ma dan karamin abun makale takarda a microsoft office.
translations.hypothesis: "الأدوات (scaffolds) نُمي يوكو، و هَذَا يعني، مُعَلِم هو نوع من الأدوات، لكن هَذَا لا يَمُدّ إلى "مُحاذاة" (little paperclip man) الموجود في Microsoft Office.

translations.source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Ana saka kariya cikin manhajojin domin su yi tambaya, su yi nuni da bada bayanai wadanda dalibai su kadai ba za su iya fuskanta ba.
translations.hypothesis: "الأسس الافتراضية هما جزء مدمج في البرمجيات، وهما مخصصان لتقديم الأسئلة، التوجيه، وشرح الإجراءات التي قد تكون صعبة للغاية بالنسبة للطالب ليتمكن من التعامل معها بمفرده."

translations.source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.reference: Ana sanya yara a Gidan Reno saboda dalilai masu yawa da suka hada da sakaci, zin zarafi, har ma zuwa ƙwace.
translations.hypothesis: المن، يُضار في رعاية مؤقتة لعدة الأسباب، بداء إهمال، إلى سوء معاملة، وحتى ابتزاز.

translations.source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.reference: Bai kamata a ce akwai yaron da zai girma a cikin muhallin da babu reno, kulawa da kuma almantarwa, amma suna yi.
translations.hypothesis: لا ينبغي لأي طفل أن يضطر إلى كبر في بيئة تفتقر إلى رعاية، تعليم، وداعم، ولكنه يضطر.

translations.source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.reference: Mun fahimci Tsarin Kulawa na jarirai ya zama yankin aminci ga waɗannan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Наша таजु, سستم ؤف فۆستر كاري, هو ؤن ؤن ؤن ؤن.

translations.source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Ya kamata tsarinmu na karɓar riko ya samar da gidaje masu aminci, masu reno da ke nuna soyayya, ingantaccen ilimi, da tabbataccen tsarin kulawa da lafiya.
translations.hypothesis: النظام الذي نستخدمه لتربية الأيتام, يهدف إلى توفير سكن آمن, رعاية أمينة, تعليم ثابت, و رعاية طبية موثوقة.

translations.source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.reference: Yakamata renon yara ya samar da dukkan bukatu wadanda su ke da bukatu a gidan da aka dauko su.
translations.hypothesis: "الرعاية المؤقتة (Foster care) ياكل أن توفر كل ما يفتقدونه في المنزل الذي كانوا فيه من قبل."

translations.source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.reference: Yanar gizo ta hada abubuwa biyu na sadarwar tsakanin al’umma da daidaikun mutane.
translations.hypothesis: الإنترنت يجمع بين يركب الاتصال الجماعي و الاتصال بين الأفراد.

translations.source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.reference: Kyakyawan halaye na intanet suna haifar da karin girma dangane da matakan gamsarwa.
translations.hypothesis: الخاصيات البارزة للإنترنت، يساهم في إضافة أبعاد جديدة فيما يتعلق بالطرق التي نستخدمها وكيف نحصل على فائدة منها.

translations.source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: Alal misali, “koyo” da “cudanya” ana kallonsu a matsayin muhimman hanyoyin ƙarfafa yin amfani da yanar gizo (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: على سبيل المثال، "تعلم" و "تفاعل" يُقترح كأسباب مهمة لاستخدام الإنترنت (جيمس وما إلى ذلك، 1995).

translations.source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.reference: “Shiga cikin mutum” da “ci gaba da dangantaka” na cikin sabbin fannonin kwarin gwiwa ta Eighmey da McCord (1998) yayinda suka bincika daukin masu sauraro a gidajen yanar gizo.
translations.hypothesis: "مشاركه عاطفية" و "علاقات ناشفات" زَا هما يوه، و هما سياستو ريادي, سُني سُني Eighmey و McCord (1998), حين سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني سُني translations.source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.reference: Amfani da rikodin bidiyo ya haifar da bincike mai mahimmanci a cikin fassara bayanan fuska, motsin fuska waɗanda ba sa wuce lokaci ƙalilan.
translations.hypothesis: استخدام تدوير (video recording) قد متاح גילויات مهمة בفك رموز הבעات קטנות, حركات الوجه اللاتي دايتوه ثواني.

translations.source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.reference: Musamman ma kamar, ikirarin da ya yi cewa zai gano ko mutum yana karyar fassarar/fahimtar kananan maganganu yadda suke.
translations.hypothesis: بشكل خاص، يُزعم أَن إحداك يُمكِن أن يكتشف هَل مُرَاعَة يَاْوُ، مِن خلال تفسير دقيق لِتعبيرات صغيرا.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.reference: A cikin takardar shi mai take Jawabin Shugaba Oliver Sacks ya bayyana yadda mutane dake fuskantar masala wajen fahimtar jawabi bisa ga masalar tabin kwakwalwa, yace duk da haka suna iya fahimtar gaskiya daidai.
translations.hypothesis: أوليفر ساكس، في المقال שלו "خطاب الرئيس"، أشار إلى طريقة التي الأشخاص اللاتي لا ي理解وا الكلام بسبب تلف الدماغ، لا يزال بإمكانهم تقييم الصدق بدقة.

translations.source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.reference: Har ma yana ba da shawarar cewa irin waɗannan damar a fassara halayen mutane za su iya rabawa ta dabbobi kamar su karnukan gida.
translations.hypothesis: حتى ي提حو، أَن قدرات سَاي في تفسير السلوك البشري، داي تكون موجودة في حَيوانات، kamar سلالة الكلاب.

translations.source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Binciken ƙarni na ashirin ya nuna cewa akwai rabe-raben halittar gado guda biyu: ɓoyayye da na bayyananne.
translations.hypothesis: البحوث التي أُجريت في القرن العشرين قد ثَبَّتَتْ أَن هناك نوعين من التنوع الوراثي: ال secret و ال manifest.

translations.source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Maye gurbi yana ƙara sabon bambancin kwayoyin, kuma zaɓi ya cire shi daga tafkin bambancin da aka bayyana.
translations.hypothesis: "تغيير يضيف وارياسيون جيني ؤيا، ؤن واختيار يَرُوهُ من مجموع وارياسيون ؤيا."

translations.source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Rabuwa da sake haduwa iri dabam-dabam baya da gaba tsakanin gidan ruwan guda biyu a kowace karni.
translations.hypothesis: الفصل والدمج يغيرون التنوع باستمرار بين اليمين واليسار، مع كل جيل.

translations.source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.reference: A can cikin yankin savanna, yana da wahala ga wata halitta dangin biri da ke da tsarin narkewar abinci irin na mutum ta iya gamsar da buƙatunta na sinadarin amino daga albarkatun tsirrai da ake da su.
translations.hypothesis: فِيمَا يخص السهول، يواجه الحيوانات ذوات الجهاز الهضمي المشابه لجسم البشري, صعوبة في تلبية احتياجاتها من الأحماض الأمينية من الموارد النباتية المتاحة.

translations.source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Bugu da ƙari, ƙin yin hakan yana tattare da munanan sakamako:kamar rashin yin girma, rashin abinci mai gina jiki, da kuma a karshe mutuwa.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك, إذا لم يتم ذلك, يواجه معه عواقب خطيرة: يرق, سوء تغذية, و في النهاية, الموت.

translations.source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.reference: Ma’dinan tsirrai da aka fi saurin amfani da su sun kasance sunadaran gina jiki da za'a iya samu a ganye da ƙwaya, amma waɗannan suna da tauri ga halittu irin mu wajen narkewa har sai an dafa su.
translations.hypothesis: أكثر أشكال الموارد النبتية اللاتي يسهل الوصول إليها هما البروتينات الموجودة في الأوراق والنباتات، ولكن هذه صعبة للهومين مثلنا لإن يتم هضمها، إلا إذا تم طهيها.

translations.source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: Sabanin haka, abincin dabbobi (tururuwa, gara, ƙwai) ba kawai ana iya narkewa cikin sauƙi ba, amma suna samar da sunadarai masu yawa waɗanda ke ɗauke da dukkan muhimman amino acid.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، غازات (الذباب، النمل، البيض) ليس فقط يسهل هضمها، بل إنها توفر بروتينات عالي، والتي تحتوي على جميع الأحماض الأمينية الضرورية.

translations.source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.reference: In an yi la’akari da dukkan abubuwa, bai kamata mu yi mamaki ba idan magabatanmu suka magance “matsalar kayan gina jiki” ta irin hanyar da goggon biri a yankin savanna suke yi a yau.
translations.hypothesis: حسب كل ما هو ملاحظ, لا ينبغي أن نشعر مدهوشين إذا أجدادنا قد حلوا "مشكلة البروتين" שלהم بطريقة م相似 مع الطريقة التي يفعلها القرود في السهوب اليوم.

translations.source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.reference: Katse bacci yanayi ne na farkawa da gangan cikin lokacin yin bacci na al’ada da kuma komawa bacci cikin dan kaknkanin lokaci daga baya (minti 10-60).
translations.hypothesis: "Cut da lokacin, yana da mataki na yi sa'a a lokacin da kake, sannan kuma yin tunani (10-60 minu).

translations.source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.reference: Za'a iya yin wannan a saukake ta hanyar amfani da kararrawa mara kara sosai da zai tashe ka ba tare da ya wartsakar da kai ba.
translations.hypothesis: هذا نُمكِن إنجازه بسهولة, سَاعَة رَن، تُمكِن أن تُخاطِبك بِصوت خفيف, لِتُوقِظَك بِشكل خفيف, بِدون أن تُوقِظَك بِشكل كَمِل.

translations.source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: Idan ka sami kanka ka sake saita agogo a cikin barcinka, ana iya sanya shi a ɗaya gefen ɗakin, yana tilasta ka tashi daga kan gado don kashe shi.

translations.source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.reference: Yawan kwanciyar hankali da mutum yake da shi ya danganta da kishiyantar yawan tashin hankali a cikin jikin mutum da ruhunsa.
translations.hypothesis: مقدار الاطمئنان ؤنบุคคล يمتلك، يختلف ؤن مقدار الضغط ؤن رَجُل.

translations.source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.reference: Rage tashin hankali, haka kuma yawan fata na gari da ƙarfin rayuwa zai gabatar. Ko wani mutum na da damar samun kwanciyar hankali da gamsuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Чем нис, त tekanan, тем, ƙarin ƙarfin rayuwa. ƴar ƴar ɗan adam da ƙimar ɗaukar daɗin da ƙarfina.

translations.source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.reference: Kowa zai iya cimma wayewa. Abinda kawai ke tsaye kan hanyar wannan burin shine tashin hankali da fargaba.
translations.hypothesis: Kullum yana iya ɗaukar ilimi. Ɗaya na hanya ta wannan kalaman shine ƙaunai kuma ɗaukar hanya.

translations.source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.reference: Buddhist na Tibet ya dogara ne da koyarwar Buddha, amma hanyar mahayana da ta hanyar fasahar India da yawa sun ninka ta.
translations.hypothesis: البوذية التبتية نبعت من таъlimu na Buddha, ولكنه نُقَل وتوسعت من خلال مسار "محayana" ذي محبة، و أيضًا من تقنيات شائعات من اليوجا الباكستانية.

translations.source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.reference: A bisa ƙa’ida Budancin Tibet yana da sauƙi. Ya kunshi tsarin motsa jiki na Yoga, kadaicewa domin tunani da kuma bin tafarkin son kowa da komai.
translations.hypothesis: عامه، البوذية التيبتية هي ممارسة البسيط. تشتمل على يوغا كونداليني، التأمل، و طريق المحبة الشاملة.

translations.source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.reference: Da Kundalini Yoga an samar da kuzarin Kundalini (kuzarin wayarwa da kai) an farka ta hanyar motsawar jiki, motsawar nufanci, mantras da ganin wa.
translations.hypothesis: با يوغا, طاقة "Kundalini" (طاقة المعرفة) تُفعّال من خلال وضعيات يوغا, تمرين تنفس, مانترا, و تصوير.

translations.source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.reference: Ginshiƙen tunanun Tibetan shi ne Abin Bauta Yoga. Duk da yake kafafen gani na abubuwan bauta daban-daban hanyoyin makamashi an tsaftace su, akan buɗe chakras inda ake ƙirƙirar tunanin wayewa.
translations.hypothesis: المركز الأساسي لتدريب التبتي هو "يوغا الله". من خلال تصوير مختلف الآله، القنوات للطاقة تُنظف، العقد تُفعّل، ووعي التنوير يُنشأ.

translations.source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.reference: Jamus abokiyar gabar kowa ce a Yakin Duniya ta 2, wanda hakan ta haifar da haɗin kai tsakanin Tarayyar Sobiyet da Amurka. Da ƙarewar yakin sai sabanin tsarin rayuwa, al’amura da al'adu ya jawo rabuwar kan ƙasashen.
translations.hypothesis: الألمان كانو శత్రు, و هذا ناɗa cikin מלחמת העולם الثانية, و يƊa cikin  cooperación tsakanin СССР و USA. Ɗan mawaƙa, الأساليب, و الثقافة, يƊa cikin ƙaraƙƙara tsakanin ƙasashe.

translations.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.

translations.source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.reference: An tsara zai kai shekaru 40 masu zuwa kuma za ayi yaƙe shi a hakika,ta sojojin haya, a filayen yaƙi daga Africa zuwa Asia, a Afghanistan, Cuba da sauran wurare da dama.
translations.hypothesis: wannan za ta darrus 40 shehu, kuma za a yi aikin, ta hanyar kungiya, a wuraren harbul, daga Afirka zuwa Asia, a Afghanistan, Cuba, da manyan wurin.

translations.source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.reference: Ya zuwa 17 ga Satumba, 1939, tsaron Poland ya riga ya karye, kuma fatan kawai da ake da shi shine na janyewa sannan a sake shiri a kan tozon gadar Romania.
translations.hypothesis: حزيران، 17, 1939, قوة الدفاع البولندية تراجعت، وبقية الأمل هو التراجع وإعادة تنظيم القوات على طول جسر الروماني.

translations.source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.reference: Koda yake wannan shiri ya tashi daga aiki dare ɗaya, yayin da sama da sojoji 800,000 na tarayyar Soviet su ka shiga Belarus da Ukraine inda su ka shata fagen daga bayan mamayar kasar Poland wanda ya karya yarjejeniyar sulhu da aka yi a Riga, sulhu zaman lafiya na kasashen Soviet da Poland da ma wasu yarjeniyoyin na kasashen duniya tsakanin kasarshe biyu ko fiye da haka.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، هذه التخطيطات بداءت أن تصبح قديمة بسرعة، عندما ما يزيد عن 800,000 عسكري من جيش الأحمر السوفياتي، دخلو و أنشأوا جبهات البيلاروسية و الأوكرانية بعد غزو المناطق الشرقية من بولندا، في خرق معاهدة السلام في ريغا، و اتفاقية عدم غزو بين السوفيات و البولنديين، و معاهدات دولية، ثنائية و متعددة الأطراف.

translations.source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.reference: Amfani da jirgin ruwa domin kwasan kayayyaki shine mafi inganci wajen kwasan mutane da yawa da kayayyaki ta teku.
translations.hypothesis: استخدام سفن لترانسفير البضائع هو الطريقة الأكثر فعالية لترانسفير كثرت من الناس والبضائع عبر المحيطات.

translations.source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.reference: Ainihin aikin sojojin ruwa shine domin tabbatar cewa kasarka ta kula da iyawa domin motsa mutanenka da kayayyaki, yayinda kuma a lokaci daya, tsoma baki da kokarin da abokan gaba ke yi domin tafiyar da mutane da kayayyaki.
translations.hypothesis: المهام التي تقوم بهاกองเรือ، مالي، هي التأكد من أن البلد يمتلك القدرة على نقل رعاياه وممتلكات، وفي نفس الوقت، التدخل في قدرة العدو على نقل رعاياه وممتلكات.

translations.source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin fitattun misalai na kwana nan game da wannan shine gumurzun yankin Atlantika ta Arewa lokacin Yakin Duniya na biyu. Amurkawa suna ƙoƙarin jigilar da sojoji da kayan yaki zuwa ƙetarenTekun Atlantika don taimakawa Biritaniya.
translations.hypothesis: فالأحد من الأمثلة البارزة الأخير، هو حملة "الشمالية الأطلسية" في الحرب العالمية الثانية. الأмериканية كانا يهدفون إلى نقل رعايا وعتاد عبر المحيط الأطلسي للمساعدة لبريطانيا.

translations.source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.reference: A lokaci daya, dakarun ruwa na Jamus, ta hanyar amfani da jirgin U-boats, na kokarin tsayar da wannan cinkoson.
translations.hypothesis: А, בله، القوات البحرية الألمانية، ساوية בעיקר על סفن غواصة, كانا يهدفون إلى وقف wannan ayyuka.

translations.source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Da Sojan taron dangi ba su yi nasara ba, watakila da Jamus ta iya yi mamaye Biritaniya kamar ta sauran Turai.
translations.hypothesis: إِنْ ائتلاف القوى لا ينجح، فمن المحتمل أن ألمانيا قادرة على غزو بريطانيا، لكونها تسيطر على بقية أورোপ.

translations.source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Ana ganin akuya ta kasance gida ta farko kusan shekaru 10,000 da suka gabata a tsaunukan Zagros na Iran.
translations.hypothesis: يبدو أن الأغنام سُلالة أول مرة, בערך 10,000 عام مضى, في جبال زاجروس, الموجودة في إيران.

translations.source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.reference: Al’adu da ƙabilun zamanin da ne su ka fara adana su domin sauƙin samun madara, gashi, nama, da kuma fatu.
translations.hypothesis: الأجاويد وعشائر قديمين بداءوا في الاحتفاظ به لغرض سهولة الحصول على حليب، شعر، گوشت، و جل.

translations.source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.reference: A koyaushe ana ajiye awakin gida a cikin garken shanun da ke yawo a kan tsaunuka ko wasu wuraren kiwo, galibi masu kiwon awaki waɗanda yara da samari ne ke kula da su, kwatankwacin sanannen makiyayi. Wadannan hanyoyin kiwo har yanzu ana amfani dasu.
translations.hypothesis: غالبًا ما يُربي الأغنام المحلية في مجموعات، اللاتي يترواحون في التلال أو مناطق أخرى للاكل، وعادة ما يتم رعاياها من قبل مربي أغنام، اللاتي غالبًا ما هما أطفال أو مراهقين، على غرار مربي أغنام المألوف. هذه الطرق للاعتناء بالأغنام لا تزال تُستخدم حتى اليوم.

translations.source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.reference: An samar da layukan tarago a Ingila tun a wajejen Ƙarni na 16.
translations.hypothesis: طرق ركوب قطار (Wagonways) نا'am bayar da a England, tun daga shekarar 16.

translations.source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.reference: Duk da cewa keken dokin sun kunshi katako a jere, amma su kan ba da dama ga dawakan da ke jan su yin sauri tare da jan manyan kaya fiye da a kan hanyoyi masu gargada na zamanin.
translations.hypothesis: باغت، و هي ببساطة تتكون من لوح خشب متوازٍ، ساعدت خيول التي تستخدمها على تحقيق سرعات أعلى و حمل أحمال أكبر مقارنة مع الطرق التي كانت موجودة في ذلك الوقت.

translations.source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.reference: An sanya Crossties tun da wuri don su tsayar layukan. Sai dai, hankali, an gano cewa layukan za su fi dacewa idan suna da ɗori na ƙarfe a saman su.
translations.hypothesis: "الأساسات (Crossties) سُئِلَ في وقت مبكر لكي يُثبت مسارات السكك الحديدية. البداية، ومع ذلك، سُئِلَ أن المسارات ستكون أكثر فعالية إذا كان لديهم طبقة من الحديد في الأعلى."

translations.source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.reference: Wannan ya zama aikin gama gari, sai ƙarfe ya haifar da ƙarin lalacewa a ƙafafun katako na kekunan.
translations.hypothesis: wannan ya ƙara ɓare, amma ƙarfe ya ƙara ƙara lalata ga ƙasa na ƙasa na ƙasa.

translations.source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.reference: Daga karshe, an sauya tayoyin katako da na karfe. A cikin 1767 an kaddamar da farkon hanyar jirgin kasa kerar karfe.
translations.hypothesis: لاحقا, عجلون شجر سُئل بـ عجلون شمع. عام 1767, عجلون شمع عالي سُئل.

translations.source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.reference: Hanyar sufuri ta farko da aka sani ita ce tafiya da ƙafa, mutane sun fara tafiya a miƙe shekaru miliyan biyu da suka gabata lokacin bayyanawar Homo Erectus (ma'ana miƙaƙƙen mutum).
translations.hypothesis: أول وسيلة نقل المألوفة هي المشي، البشريون مطلعوه يمشون بشكل صحيح يورو مليون عام مضى، مع ظهور Homo Erectus (وهو يعني "بشري يمش بشكل صحيح").

translations.source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.reference: Magabatan su, Australopithecus ba su yi tafiya miƙe ba kamar yadda ya ke a ɗabi’ance.
translations.hypothesis: سلف su, Australopithecus, لا يمشون kamar yadda su ke.

translations.source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.

translations.source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.reference: Bayan Majalisar wakilai ta amince da shi a ranar 4 ta Yuli, sa'an nan aka aika wani daftarin da aka rubuta da hannu wanda Shugaban Majalisar John Hancock ya sa hannu da ɗan nesa zuwa ga shagon buga rubutu na John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: بعد ما Congress ya aminkan wannan, 4 ga Yuli, سورة ما ta da sana, wanda ta kasance da signature na President na Congress, John Hancock, da kuma Secretary, Charles Thomson, an saki ta zuwa ofishin zazzabawa na John Dunlap, wanda yana da makonni.
