translations.source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.reference: Kamar yadda hukumomin gandun daji suka fada, tsaya aƙalla nisan yadi/mita 100 daga dabbobin bear da kerkeci da yadi/mita 25 daga sauran dabbobin daji!
translations.hypothesis: حسب ما قيل من دار الإدارة، يرجى البقاء على بعد 100 ياردة/متر من الدببة و الذئاب، و 25 ياردة/متر من كلاً من الحيوانات البرية الأخرى!

translations.source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.reference: Ko da yaya dolancin su yake, bison, elk, moose, bears, da kusan dukkanin manyan dabbobi za su iya kai hari.
translations.hypothesis: بغض النظر عن مظهرهم، البيسون، الأيل، الأيل، الدب، ووهي حيوانات ضخمة، يُمكن أن يهاجموا.

translations.source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.reference: A duk shekara, gwamman maziyarta na samun raunuka sakamakon gaza bada tazara da ta dace. Kuma dabbobin manya ne, masu fada kuma su na da hadarin gaske, don haka sai an basu tazara.
translations.hypothesis: Саку, दर्जन ها، رцаў يوا سُكّان يroffen, لاء سُكّان يَرِي يَرِي. هاو هَذَا هَذَا, هَذَا, وَ يَعْطِي.

translations.source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.reference: Bugu da ƙari, ka sani cewa ƙamshi na janyo bear da waɗansu namun daji, don haka guji ɗauka ko dafa abinci mai ƙamshi da kuma tsaftace sansani.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك, يرجى ملاحظة أَن الروائح يظاهِرون حمار وحشي و سائر حيوات, لِذلك يرجى تجنب أكل أو إعداد طعام ذي رائحة, و الحفاظ على موقع التخييم نظيف.

translations.source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.reference: Apia ce babban birnin Samoa. Garin yana kan tsibirin Upolu kuma yana da yawan al’umma da kadan ya gaza da 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia هي عاصمة Samoa. البلدة تقع على جزيرة Upolu، ودارتها يبلغ ما يقرب من 40,000 ر person.

translations.source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.reference: An kafa Apia a shekarun 1850s kuma ta kasance ita ce babban birnin Samoa a hukumance tun 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apia تأسست مكي 1850s، و هي عاصمة رسمي لساموا تاي 1959.

translations.source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.reference: Tashar jiragen ruwan ta kasance wurin da aka yi kaurin suna a tashe-tashen hankula a cikin 1889 lokacin da jiragen ruwa bakwai daga Jamus, Amurka, da Biritaniya suka ƙi barin tashar.
translations.hypothesis: الميناء كان موقع ياشاع عن مواجهة بحرية عام 1889، حين سبعة سفن من ألمانيا، الولايات المتحدة، و بريطانيا ترفض الخروج من الميناء.

translations.source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.reference: Duk an nutsar da jiragen ruwan, in ban da wani ƙaramin jirgin ruwan Birtaniya. Kusan rayuka 200 na Amurkawa da Jamusawa aka rasa.
translations.hypothesis: كُل سفن غرق، باستثناء سفينة بحرية بريطانية وحيدة. ما لا يقل عن 200 رفات أمريكيين و الألمان.

translations.source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

translations.reference: Akwai gaɓar teku mai rairayi da dama, sakamakon zagaye tasoshin jiragen ruwa biyu da Auckland ta yi. Fitattun cikinsu suna cikin yankuna uku.
translations.hypothesis: لاع, و هَذَا يَتِم بسبب موقع مدينة أوكلاند, اللاتي تقع بين اثْنَيْنِ مَجاري مياه. الأهم والأكثر شهرة هَذَان يقعان في ثلاثة مناطق.

translations.source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.reference: Rairayin bakin tekun North Shores (a gundumar North Harbour) suna kan Tekun Pacific sannan suka miƙa daga Long Bay a arewa zuwa Devonport a kudu.
translations.hypothesis: غايات شاطئ (بالمحلل شاطئ) يقعون في المحيط الهادئ، و يمتدون من Bay da gabas zuwa Devonport da gabas.

translations.source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.reference: Kusan dukan su beach ne masu kasa da kuma wurin iyo a kwanciyar hankali, kuma yawancin su suna da inuwa da bishiyun pohutukawa ke bayarwa.
translations.hypothesis: غالبًا هما شواطئ رملية، شائعات، و ه̀u، و أغلبها لديه غطاء شجر، و ه̀u.

translations.source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.reference: Kogin Tamaki Drive suna kan Waitemata Harbor, a cikin manyan unguwannin bayan gari na Mission Bay da St Heliers a Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: غرف شاطئ Tamaki Drive يقعان على ميناء Waitemata, في المناطق الراقية جدًا, Mission Bay و St Heliers, الموجودة في وسط Auckland.

translations.source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.reference: Wani lokaci akwai gabobin bakin ruwa da ke cunkushe da iyalai da kuma jerin kantuna. Yin ninkaya a wajen ba shi da hadari.
translations.hypothesis: यी هما ساحات شاطئ عائلي, ؤتا هما يغون, ؤتا دار da manyan kasuwa da ke da a shim. ؤتا da tafiya da tafiya da za ta, wannan yana da amana.

translations.source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.reference: Giya ta gida da aka sani ita ce ‘Ta Ɗaya’, ba giya ce mai haɗe-haɗe ba, amma tana da daɗi da wartsakarwa. Ana kiran daya giyar ta gida “Manta”.
translations.hypothesis: البيرا البايئة העיקרית هي 'Number One'، لاءديها، بل هي بيرا ساهلة وتاع. و بيرا البايئة الباƙيرة تسمى "Manta".

translations.source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.reference: Akwai giya na Faransa da yawa da za a ci, amma giyar New Zealand da Ostiraliya na iya tafiya mafi kyau.
translations.hypothesis: هناك شايين ريف الفرنسية، ولكنه شايين ريف نيوزيلاندا و أستراليا قد يجدون طريقه بسهولة.

translations.source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.reference: Ruwan famfon na gida yana da cikakkiyar tsabta don sha, amma ruwan kwalba na da saukin samu idan kana fargaba.
translations.hypothesis: الأنابيب المائية الموجودة في البلد هي آمنة للاستخدام، ولكن، إذا كنت قلق، فمن السهل العثور على مياه المعلب.

translations.source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.reference: Ga ƴan Australiya, manufar kofi na 'flat white' bakon abu ne. Wani bakar gajeren kofi na 'espresso', yana cike da maiko (ba kumfa ba), ana shan shayi ba tare da madara ba.
translations.hypothesis: "غالبًا, فكرة "كوفي فلات وايت" لاهالي أستراليا لاء. "كوفي شورت بلاك" هو "إسبريسو", "كابوتشينو" yana da ƙara da ƙara (غالبًا لاء, لاء), kuma "شاي" يُسَلَّم دون ماء.

translations.source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.reference: Alawar mai zafi ta kai matsayi irin wadda Belgium ta kayyade. Abin sha na kayan itace na da tsada amma akwai dadi.
translations.hypothesis: شوكولات المشروب يلتزم بمعايير بلجيكية. شاي العصير غالي، ولكنه رائع.

translations.source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.reference: Yawancin tafiye-tafiye zuwa kasan ana yin su duka shekara, kuma raunin da ya auku dalilin kowane dayan daga cikin wadannan sabubba na karkashin ruwa na da karanci.

translations.source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.reference: Har yanzu, nemi shawara daga hukumomi, yin biyayya ga dukkan alamu, da kuma kula sosai game da gargadin lafiya.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، يرجى الاستماع إلى مشورة, اتبع جميع الإشارات, و انتبه بشدة إلى تنبيهات أمنية.

translations.source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.reference: Gungun jellyfish na taruwa a kusa da rairayin bakin teku da kuma kusa da bakin kogi inda ya hadu da teku tsakanin watannin Oktoba zuwa Afrilu a arewacin 1770. Amma ana iya samunsu jefi jefi a wasu lokutan ma.
translations.hypothesis: جلبية (Box jellyfish) نا farko cikin cikin  littoral (sharu) و cikin cikin madaidai, daga Oktoba zuwa Fabrairu, kusa da geogar 1770. Za a iya gauran su ba tare ga wannan lokacin ba.

translations.source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.reference: Akwai shark a zahiri amma basu fiya kawowa mutane hari ba. Yawancin sharks suna tsoron mutane kuma guduwa zasuyi.
translations.hypothesis: "بش, هالب, amma rakan yana faruwa cikin ƙasa. Ƙad yana ɓashin mutane kuma za su ɓace.

translations.source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.reference: Kada din ruwa me gishiri basa yawan zama a teku, wurn zaman su shine kududufi estuaries arewa ga Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: القرشيات المالح لا يعيشون بفعالية في المحيط، بل موطنهم الأساسي هو في مجاري الأنهار بالقرب من روك كامبون.

translations.source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.reference: Biya da wuri tana ba da mafita tare da tafiye-tafiye na fili. Studentsalibai na iya kallon kayan tarihin, ziyartar akwatin kifaye, ko kuma sha'awar kyawawan fasaha yayin zama tare da ajinsu.
translations.hypothesis: حجز مسبقely يمنح المسافر تأكيد وهدوء ذهن، أي أنه سيحصل على مكان للنوم بمجرد وصوله إلى وجهته.

translations.source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.reference: Ma'aikatan tafiye-tafiye galibi suna da ma'amala tare da takamaiman otal, kodayake kuna iya samun damar tsara wasu nau'o'in masauki, kamar filayen zangon, ta hanyar wakilin balaguro.
translations.hypothesis: وكلاء السفر عادةً ما يمتلكون مهار, مع فنون متميزة, ولكنه يواجهون إمكانية حجز أنواع سياحية, kamar wurin camp, ta hany mai sadar su.

translations.source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.reference: Dillalan zirga-zirga galibi suna bayar da hasafin karya kumallo da tsara tafiye-tafiye - na zuwa da dawowa - daga filin jiragen sama ko kuma su kan hada har da na tafiyar jiragen da kuma na otel.
translations.hypothesis: وكلاء السفر عادةً ما يُقدِّمون باقات ركاب, wanda ya shafi abin sa'a, ayyuka don shiga/fita daga ؤر, ko har da ayyuka na tafiya ؤ hotell.

translations.source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.reference: Hakanan zasu iya riƙe ajiyar a gare ku idan kuna buƙatar lokaci don tunani game da tayin ko samo wasu takardu don zuwa (misali visa).
translations.hypothesis: هذان ي asemenea, ي iya ɗaukar ƙoƙarin shiga tare da kai, idan kana buƙata don ɗaukar lokaci don ɗaukar karar ko kuma Ƙawo wani dokumens don wurarka (misali: visa).

translations.source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.reference: Duk wani gyara ko buƙata za a tura ta wurin jami’in tafiye-tafiye da farko ba kai tsaye zuwa otal ba.
translations.hypothesis: أي التغييرات أو لاحقات, بايد يُجروا من خلال وكيل السفر أولاً, ومن لا مباشرة مع الفندق.

translations.source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.reference: Don wasu bukukuwa, yawancin masu halarta zuwa bukukuwa na kiɗa sun yanke shawara su yi zango a wurin, kuma yawancin masu halarta suna ɗaukar shi muhimmin ɓangare na ƙwarewar.
translations.hypothesis: عن بَعْض المهرجان, أغلب من يشارك فيه يقررون البقاء في الموقع, و أغلب يرى wannan كجزء مهم من التجربة.

translations.source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.reference: Idan kana so ka yi kusa da inda mataki ke faruwa sai ka shiga da wuri domin samun sansani kusa da kidi da waka.
translations.hypothesis: إِنْ كُنْتَ رَغْبَة فِي كَوْنَ قَرِيب مِن الأنشطة، زَامْ سَاعَة سَعَة لِتَجِدْ مَكانَ لِتَخِيمَة قَرِيب مِن الموسيقى.

translations.source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.reference: Duk wanda zai yo tuƙi a wurare masu tsananin tudu ko ta kan hanyoyin kan tsauni ya kula da yiwuwar dusar ƙanƙara, ƙanƙara, ko yanayin sanyi mai tsanayi.
translations.hypothesis: أي شخص الذي ينوون القيادة في مناطق باردة أو فوق جبال، يجب أن يضع في الاعتبار احتمال وجود ثلوج، جليد، أو درجات حرارة منخفضة.

translations.source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.reference: A wajaje masu kankara, ko sanyi halin jiki na zama matsakaici ne a kasashe da yawa, kuma cinkoso na cigabawa ne ba tare da tsayawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: על الطرق ذي جليد و ثلوج، الاحتكاك ضئيل, kuma لا يمكنك القيادة كما لو كنت على طريق أسفلت عادي.

translations.source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.reference: A lokacin guguwar dusar kankara, dusar kanakara kan iya ajiye ku a wuri daya lokacin fadawa a cikin karamin lokaci.
translations.hypothesis: Среди "بيا", قد يظهر الثلوج الكثيرة cikin  kurzer זמן, حتى يجعلك عالق.

translations.source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.reference: Hakanan ana iya taƙaita ganuwa ta faɗuwa ko busar da dusar ƙanƙara ko ta iska ko kankara akan windows abin hawa.
translations.hypothesis: همچنین, رؤية можа أن تضعف بسبب هطول ثلوج أو رياح، أو بسبب تكوين بخار أو جل على زجاج ركوب.

translations.source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.reference: A gefe guda, yanayin kankara da dusar ƙanƙara sun zama al'ada a ƙasashe da yawa, kuma yawancin zirga-zirga ba a katsewa duk shekara.
translations.hypothesis: Аkwai, هَذَا، حالة البَرَد و الثلوج شائعة في كثرة الأ 나라، و ترافیک يواصل عدا دون توقف طوال العام.

translations.source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.reference: Watakila Safaris ita ce mafi girman zane-zanen yawon buda ido a Afirka kuma abin birgewa ga baƙi da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: "Safaris, kamar yadda ake ɗaukar, shine daya daga cikin ayyuka na shiga da jama'a na mashahara a Afrika, kuma yana da muhimmanci ga masu ziyarata."

translations.source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.reference: Kalmar safari an fi danganta da masu bulaguro a kafa domin kallon kyawawan namun daji na Afirka, musamman yankuna marasa duhu da ciyawa sosai.
translations.hypothesis: المصطلح "سافاري" بانتشار, يُشير إلى السفر عبر اليابسة لغرض مشاهدة الحياة البرية الرائعة في أفريقيا، وخاصة في السهول.

translations.source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.reference: Wasu dabbobi, kamar giwaye da raƙuman dawa, su kan je kusa da motoci kuma na’ura mai kyau za ta ba da damar kallo sosai.
translations.hypothesis: فَتات, kamar حمار و زراف, يميلون إلى الاقتراب من سيارات, و أدوات معياري ستسمح برؤية جيدة.

translations.source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.reference: Zakuna, damisar cheetah da ta leopard wasu lokuta suna kaucewa mutane kuma za ku fi ganin su sosai maduban hangen nesa.
translations.hypothesis: الأسود، الشاهين، و السنور، هما أحياناً خجولين، و ستحتاج إلى استخدام عدسة مكبرة (binoculars) لترى هؤلاء الحيوانات بشكل أوضح.

translations.source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.reference: Safari na tafiya (wanda ake kira “tafiyar daji”, “safari maiyawo”, ko tafiya “ƙafa”) ya ƙunshi yin yawo, ko dai na awanni ko kwanaki da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: سفر سير (المعروف أيضًا باسم "سفر في البر", "سفر مشي", أو "سفر سير") يتضمن المشي، سواء لعدد ساعات أو يوماً.

translations.source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.reference: Za a gudanar da wasannin nakasassu daga 24 ga Agusta zuwa 5 ga Satumba 2021. Za a gudanar da wasu abubuwan a wasu wurare a duk fadin Japan.
translations.hypothesis: المهرجان الرياضي لذوي الإعاقة سيمر من 24 أغسطس إلى 5 سبتمبر 2021.  فرا بعض الفعاليات س held في أماكن نا, في شتى أجزاء اليابان.

translations.source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo za ta kasance gari daya tilo na Asiya da ya taba karbar bakuncin wasannin Olympics karo biyu, bayan da ta dauki nauyin wasannin a shekarar 1964.

translations.source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.reference: Beraye da dangoginsu kan bata abinci sannan su janyo kaikayi ko kuma ma su haddasa kan jiki tare da yada guba ko kuma ma baza cututtuka.
translations.hypothesis: الآفات (الديدان، الحشرات, وما إلى ذلك) زال يفسد الأكل، يسبب تهيج، أو في أسوأ الحالات، يسبب ردود فعل تحسسية، ينشر سم، أو ينقل الأمراض.

translations.source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.

translations.source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.reference: Matafiya zuwa ƙasashe masu tsananin haraji za su iya adana wani adadin kuɗin mai yawa a wasu lokuta n, musamman akan abubuwa kamar barasa da taba.
translations.hypothesis: سائحو masu shiga ƙasashe da ƙayyashi da ƙasa, ɓaɗe za su iya sakawa kudin da ɓaɗe, kamar da kuma kayan da suka shafi abin sha kuma taba.

translations.source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.reference: Yankin tsakanin Point Marion da Fairmont na gabatar da mafi kyawun yanayin tuƙi a kan babbar hanyar Buffalo-Pittsburgh, yana wucewa ta kowane yanki mai zaman kansa da baya.
translations.hypothesis: القسم ما بين Point Marion و Fairmont, يُمثل أصعب ظروف قيادة على طريق Buffalo-Pittsburgh, بمرور يرتاد باستمرار من خلال سهول نائية.

translations.source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.reference: Idan har ba ka saba da tuki a titunan kasar ba, to ka tattara hankalinka a kanka: kana mai hankalta da tukin da nutsuwa a titin tare da kaucewa tukin gaggawa da daga hankali.
translations.hypothesis: إِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مألوفًا قيادة على طرق ريفية، يرجى أن تكون حذر: منحدرات جَبيل، طرق ضيقة، ودوائر حادة هما السمة.

translations.source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.reference: Alamomin kayyade gudun ababen hawa sun yi karanci a nan fiye da a wuraren da ke baya - anfi samun wadanda ba sa wuce mph 35-40 (56-64 km/h) - biyayya ga alamomin na da mahimmanci maimakon rashin yi musu biyayya.
translations.hypothesis: الحدود المحددة لسرعة القيادة تظهر أن هى أقل بكثير من الموجودة في الأجزاء السابقة و اللاحقة - عادةً 35-40 ميل في الساعة (56-64 كيلومتر في الساعة) - و الامتثال لهما هو أمر بالغ الأهمية، و حتى أكثر من ذلك.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Kayan ciye-ciyen Jamusawa akwai kyau, kuma a Bavaria, suna da daɗin gaske da mabambanta, irin na maƙwabciyarsu ta kudanci, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: الخبز الألمانى شاي, و في بافاريا, هو شاي, و يختلف, و يشبه الوجبات الموجودة في جيرانهم من الجنوب, و هما النمسا.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: Abincin ƴaƴan itace sun zama ruwan dare, ta yin abinci da tufa a tsawon shekara, da kuma cherries da plums da ke bayyana lokacin bazara.
translations.hypothesis: "الأطعمة التي تُصنع من الفاكهة شائعة، حيث التفاح يُستخدم في صناعة هذه الأطعمة طوال العام، بينما التوت والبرتقال يظهرون خلال موسم الصيف.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Yawancin kayayyaki da aka dafa da Jamusanci suma suna da alamomin almara, ƙwaya, da sauran ƙwayoyin itace. Mashahurin wainar ba da daɗewa ba haɗe biyu tare da kofi mai ƙarfi.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: A cikin yankuna masu nisa na Arewacin Indiya da Pakistan, ana amfani da madala a cikin curry; a Kudancin Indiya da wasu yankuna na gabar teku na yankin, ana amfani da madarar kwakwa sosai.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Tare da tsibirai 17,000 da za a zaɓa daga ciki, abincin Indonesiya laima ce da ke rufe yawancin nau'ikan abinci na yanki da aka samo a duk faɗin ƙasar.
translations.hypothesis: حيث تتوفر 17,000 جزيرة لاختيار منها، "الأطعمة الإندونيسية" هي مصطلح شامل الذي يغطي مجموعة واسعة من المأكولات الإقليمية الموجودة في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Amma, idan aka yi amfani da shi ba tare da ƙarin ƙwarewar ba, kalmar tana nufin ma'anar abinci asali daga ɓangarorin tsakiya da gabashin babban tsibirin Java.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، إذا يُستخدم دون أي إضافات، wannan kalma cenderungiya ta ta'ana zuwa abin da ya shiga daga cikin sakan da kusa, kamar ƙasar Java.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Yanzu ana samu a faɗin rukunin tsibiran, jerin nau’ikan abincin yan Java, yawancin kayan kamshin da su ka fi sakawa shine na gyada, yaji da sukari (musamman sukarin kwakwa) da kuma wasu kayan kanshin.
translations.hypothesis: "الآن، مأكولات جاواني شائعة جدًا بجميع جزر، وتضم مجموعة متنوعة من الأطباق البسيطة، مع النكهات البارزة اللاتي يفضلها الجاويني، وهما الفول السوداني، الفلفل، السكر (خاصة سكر جواني)، وأعشاب عطرية.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Likkafa tallafi ne ga ƙafafun mahayi waɗanda su ke rataye a kowane ɓangaren sirdi.
translations.hypothesis: "Stirrups sun kasance ƙasa don ƙananen mai, kuma sun kasance a kowane gefe na ƙasa."

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Su na ba da daidaito ga matuki sai dai akwai damuwa dangane hadarin kafar matukin na iya makalewa a jiki.
translations.hypothesis: هذه توفر مزيد من الأمان للمركب، ولكنه قد يسبب مشكلات أمنية بسبب احتمال أن قد يلتصق أقدام المركب به.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: Turai nahiya ce karama amma cike da kasashe masu yancin kansu. A tsari ana iya cewa yin tafiye-tafiye tsakanin kasashen na nufin sai ka nemi takardun izinin shiga da ratsa wuraren binciken takardun tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: أوروبا هي قارة اللاتي هاء ضغيرة ولكنه دارا دول بحد ذاتها.  في الظروف العادية، السفر بين دول شتى ليعني الاضطرار إلى تقديم طلبات فيزا ومرور من خلال فحص جواز السفر مرات شتى.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Yankin Schengen, duk da haka, yana aiki kamar ƙasa ɗaya ta wannan.
translations.hypothesis: لكن منطقة شنغن، في هذا الصدد، ت function kamar wani ƙasa.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Muddin ka tsaya a wannan yankin, gabaɗaya zaka iya ƙetare iyakoki ba tare da wucewa cikin wuraren kula da fasfon ba.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: Hakanan, samun izinin shiga kasashen Schengen, ya sa baka bukatar samun izinin daidaikun kasashe da ke cikin jerin kasashen, hakan na rage asarar lokaci, kudi da cike ciken takardu.
translations.hypothesis: Баayısıyla, إيجاب visa ta Schengen, لستم ذالزام لتقديم visa zuwa duk membobin Schengen, ba tare da yin wannan ba, wannan yana ɗaukar lokaci, kuɗi, kuma ayyuka.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Babu wani ma'anar duniya wanda kayan masana'antu sune kayan tarihi. Wasu hukumomin haraji sun ayyana kayan da suka girmi shekaru 100 a matsayin kayan tarihi.
translations.hypothesis: لا يوجد تعريف عالمي لـ "عناصر صناعية" اللاتي يُعتبرن "عجائب". بضائع بعهارات تزيد عن 100 عام، تُعرّف لبعض وكالات الضرائب، كعجائب.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Ma’anar na da banbancin yanki, inda iyakar shekaru ke iya kasancewa kaɗan a wurare kamar Amurika ta Arewa fiye da ƙsashen Turai.
translations.hypothesis: التعريف يختلف باختلاف الأماكن، حيث حد السن قد يكون أقصر في أماكن مثل أเมริกา، مقارنة مع أوروبا.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Za'a iya ma'anar kayayyakin aikin hannu azaman tsoffin kayayyakin tarihi, dukda cewa sunfi saurayi irin kayan da aka girka.
translations.hypothesis: المنتجات التي تصنعها اليد قد تُعرّف كعناصر عتيقة، على الرغم من أنها أحدث من المنتجات المشابهة التي تُنتج بكميات كبيرة.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Kiwon dabbar Reindeer wani gata mai muhimmanci ne tsakanin ƴan Sámi kuma al'adar a kewayar sana'ar tana da muhimmanci kuma wajen yawanci da suke da wasu sana'o'i.
translations.hypothesis: التربية على حيوانات "رينديير" هي وسيلة لعيش مهمة لـ "السامي"، و الثقافة المجاورة لهذا العمل مهمة أيضًا لعدد كبير من الأشخاص ذوي مهن أخرى.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Duk wanda ke shirin ziyara zuwa wata ƙasa da za a iya kallonta a zaman fagen yaƙi dole ya samu horon ƙwararru.
translations.hypothesis: أي شخص يخطط لزيارة م国, اللذي يُعتبر منطقة قتال, يجب أن يكتسب بروفيسيونال (مهني) التدريب.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Binciken yanar gizo don ‘yanayin muhalli mai tsanani’ yana iya fitar adireshin wani kamfanin gargajiya.
translations.hypothesis: البحث على الإنترنت بكلمة 'دور دراسي ببيئة عادية' على الأرجح سيوفر عنوان شركة محلية.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Hanya koyaushe za ta rufe dukkan batutuwan da aka tattauna a nan cikin mafi cikakken bayani, yawanci tare da ƙwarewar aiki.
translations.hypothesis: "ساعه عادةً ستغطي كلاً من القضايا المذكورة هنا، وبشكل مفصل جدًا، وعادةً مع الخبرة العملية."

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Wani kwas wanda za a yi cikin kwana 2-5 wanda zai shafi aikin da ya kunshi horarwa kan agajin gaggawa da kuma a wasu lokutan har da horarwa na makamai.
translations.hypothesis: "Kursus ɗaya ɗaya, kuma ya shafi akeya, manyan ayyuka na ɗaukar jiran, kuma a wasu lokutan kuma shaharar da shirin."

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Littattafai da mujallu masu ma'amala da rayuwar jeji sanannu ne, amma wallafe-wallafen da ke magana game da yankunan yaƙi ba su da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: كتاب وزين، اللاتي بحد ذاتها بشان البقاء في البر, شائعات, ولكن تلك اللاتي بحد ذاتها بشان جبهات قتال, نادرة.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: dole sai matafiya masu kokarin yin tiyatar canza jinsi sun tabbatar suna dauke da ingantattun takardun tafiyar komawa gida.
translations.hypothesis: الأشخاص شاهين يخططون لإجراء جراحة لتغيير الجنس، إذا كانوا ينوون السفر إلى خارج البلاد، لابد أن يتاكدوا من أن لديهم وثائق صالحة للمغامرة.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Kaunar gwamnatoci don bayar da fasfo ɗin da jinsi ba a bayyana ba (X) ko takaddun da aka sabunta don daidaita sunan da ake so kuma jinsi ya bambanta.
translations.hypothesis: الرغبة للحكومات في إصدار جوازات سفر دون تحديد الجنس (X) أو وثائق التي تم تحديثها لتتوافق مع الاسم والجنس المرغوب، تختلف.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Kasancewar yardar gwamnatocin kasashen waje don girmama waɗannan takardu yana da saurin canzawa.
translations.hypothesis: حقيقة أن حكومتان غريبه مستعدين للامتثال لقرارات هؤلاء، تختلف بحدود.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Bincike a wuraren bincike na jami’an tsaro su ma sun zama da karin shishigi bayan zamanin Satumba 11, 2001.
translations.hypothesis: البحثات ببابي تلافي أيضًا زادت بشكل ضار بعد 11 سبتمبر، 2001.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: kada mutanen da suka sauya jinsinsu su yi tsammanin za su iya wuce wa ta gaban na’urorin haska hoton jiki ba tare da fallasar sirri da mutuncinsu ba.
translations.hypothesis: "الأشخاص ذوي الجنس غير تقليدي (transgender) בטרם جراحة, لا ينبغي أن يتوقعوا أن يمروا من خلال الماسحات الضوئية مع الحفاظ على خصوصيتهم وكرامتهم."

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Lokacin dawowa gida bayan zama a ƙasashen waje, kun saba da sabon al'adun kuma kun rasa wasu al'adunku daga al'adunku na gida.
translations.hypothesis: Lokanda daga Ƙasashen wajen, lokan kun koma gida, kun shiga cikin Ƙülturan ɓarna kuma kun ɓata ƴan abubuwan da kake yi a Ƙülturan gida.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Kasancewa a kasar waje a karo na farko, na sa matafiya yin hakuri da nuna fahimta, saboda sanin cewa matafiya na bukatar hakan domin su saba da wajen.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da kake fara zuwa wata, mutane da kusa za su kasance masu fahimta, saboda su san cewa masu tafiya zuwa wata gaba za su buƙaci su yi amfani da yanayi.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Ba lallai Mutane su fahimci cewa yin haƙuri da nuna fahimta wajibi ne ga matafiya da ke kokarin komawa gida.
translations.hypothesis: Баদু, يوا ساساي أن صبرا و fahima sun زاكاي, حتى لاهال masu tafiya.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Sautin dala da wasan haske na daya daga cikin abubuwa masu dadi a fanni kananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: "عرض الصوت والصورة بحديد هوم هي مهارة ضياع, kuma تاي زاي يноси سار.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Za ka iya ganin dalar a cikin duhu kuma za ka iya ganin su a tsanake kafin shirin ya fara.
translations.hypothesis: زusammen, زاك يرى البيدرون cikin ɗarku, kuma زاك يرى su cikin ɗauka kafin shirin ya fara.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Yawanci kodayaushe ka kan ji sautin ‘yan yawon shakatawa da masu talla. Labarin sauti da hasken to kawai kamar littafin labari ne.
translations.hypothesis: generally, زان تلاقى ساவுن ؤو باغا. هاذه القصة عن ساவுن ؤو نور تانا، تانا kamar wani bukada.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: An yi amfani da sassaken zaki na Egypt a matsayin jigo wajen bada dogon labari.
translations.hypothesis: "الـ Sphinx سُئِلَ ليكون خلفية و مُحاور في قصة الطويلة.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Ana nuna wuraren akan dalar kuma an haskaka dalolin mabambanta.
translations.hypothesis: الصور نا taso a cikin masakan, kuma masakan  المختلفة نا taso.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Tsibirin Kudancin Shetland, wanda aka gano a cikin 1819, kasashe da yawa suna da'awar su kuma suna da mafi yawan tushe, tare da goma sha shida suna aiki a 2020.
translations.hypothesis: جزر ساوث شيتلاند، سِيم سِيم عام 1819، سِيم سِيم ليف ƴuwa, kuma سِيم سِيم دار, سِيم سِيم 16 سِيم سِيم 2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: Tsibirin na kwanciye 120 km arewa da sashin kasa mai shiga teku. Mafi girma shine King George Island mai dauke da mazauna na Villa Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: الجزيرة تقع 120 كيلومتر شمال شبه الجزيرة. الأكبر بينها هو جزيرة جورج، عدا عن القرية "فيل لاس استريلا".

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Sauran sun hada da Livingston Island, da Yaudarar Inda ambaliyar caldera na har dutsen mai fitad da wuta yana ba da tashar jiragen ruwa na halitta.
translations.hypothesis: غايات سياحية ناضف, بـ "جزيرة ليڤينغستون", و "ديسيبيشن", حيث أن حفرة بركان لا يزال نشط، و التي غمرت، توفر ميناء طبيعي رائع.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land shine yanki na kudu da masarautar, da Tekun Bellingshausen ya daure.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land هي منطقة شمالي الضواحي، وتحدها بحر Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Tsaunukan da ke nan wurin a Tsibirin sun haɗe da yankin mai tudu, sannan suka sake bulla a gaba inda suka haifar da jerin carbin Tsaunukan Elsworth na tsawon kilomita 360, wanda dunkulen Ƙanƙarar Minnesota ya ratsa ta tsakiyarsu.
translations.hypothesis: الجبال الموجودة في هذه المنطقة تتحد مع السهل، ومن ثم تظهر مرة أخرى لتشكل سلسلة جبال إلسوورث، والتي يبلغ طولها 360 كيلومتر، وتتم تقسيمها بواسطة جليد مينيسوتا.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Yankin arewacin ko Sentinel Range yana da tsaunukan tsaunuka mafi girma na Antarctica, Vinson Massif, wanda yake hawa sama a tsaunin 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: القسم الشمالي أو نطاق سينتينل، يضم قمة شاهي، وهي جبل فينソン، والتي تبلغ ارتفاعها 4892 متر.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: A wurare masu nisa, idan babu sabis na wayar salula, wayar tauraron dan adam na iya zama zaɓin ku kaɗai.
translations.hypothesis: فِي الأماكن النائية, ؤnde لايوجد شبكة سيل فون, هاتف ساتلايت نا, نا كاي زام.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Wayar tauraron dan adam a gaba daya ba za ta maye gurbin wayar hannu ba, domin sai kun kasance a waje tare da yin saiti da tauraron dan adam don yin kiran da wayar.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Wani zaɓi da ya ke kara samun karbuwa ga waɗanda ke shirin ratar-shekara shine yin tafiya don sani.
translations.hypothesis: واحدة شائعة, kuma تزداد شعبية, للاشخاص اللى يخططون لسن "سنة فراغ", هي السفر و تعلم.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Wannan ya shahara musamman ga masu tsallake-tsallake a makaranta, suna basu damar ɗaukar shekara guda kafin jami'a, ba tare da lalata karatunsu ba.
translations.hypothesis: wannan yana يواكون بشكل خاص مع أولئك اللذين يخرجون من مدرسة، مما يُمكّنهم من أخذ سنة راحة قبل الالتحاق بالجامعة، دون المساس بتعليمهم.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: A lokuta da dama shiga/fara kwas na ratan shekara guda a ketare zai iya inganta damammakinka na kara nosawa gaba a karatu idan ka dawo kasar haihuwarka.
translations.hypothesis: "A cikin many rawa, irtowa cikin ko kurss na "gap year" a wata ƙasa, ɓai iya ɗaukar ƙarfi don shiga cikin ƙarshe na ilimi a ƙasarka.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Yawanci za a sami kuɗin karatun shiga don shiga cikin waɗannan shirye-shiryen ilimin.
translations.hypothesis: عادةً، ستكون هناك رسوم دراسي لكي تنضم إلى هذه البرامج الأكاديمية.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: Finland babban wurin zuwan kwalekwale ne. “Ƙasa mai tafkuna dubu” tana kuma da dubban tsibirai, a cikin tafkuna da kuma cikin rukunin tsibirai.
translations.hypothesis: Finland هي وجهة شائعة لركوب القوارب. "أرض الآلاف من البحيرات" لا يقتصر على البحيرات فحسب، بل تحتوي أيضًا على آلاف الجزر، سواء في البحيرات أو في مجموعات الجزر الساحلية.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: A yankunan masu tsibirai barjak da tafkuna ba lallaia bukaci kanana jiragen ruwaba.
translations.hypothesis: فِي مجموعات جزر و بحيرات، لستم دائمًا بحاجة إلى قارب.

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Kodayake tarin tsibirai na bakin teku da manyan tabkuna suna da girman isa ga kowane jirgin ruwa, ƙananan jiragen ruwa ko ma kayak suna ba da kwarewa daban.
translations.hypothesis: باوجود حقيقة أن جزر ساحلية الكبيرة و البحيرات الضخمة لابد أن تتناسب مع أي نوع قارب، قوارب أو حتى قارب كاياك الأصغر، يقدِّم تجربة مختلفة.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Jirgin ruwa jirgi ne na kasar Finland, tare da kwale-kwale ga kowane mutum bakwai ko takwas.
translations.hypothesis: "الركوب على قوارب هو عادة ترفيهية بوطنية في فنلندا، حيث توجد قوارب لكل سبعة أو ثمانية أشخاص."

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Wannan ya dace da Norway, Sweden da New Zealand, amma in ba haka ba ya zama na musamman (misali a cikin Netherlands adadi ɗaya ne zuwa arba'in).
translations.hypothesis: هذا يماثل نرويجيا، السويد، ونيوزيلندا، ولكنه يختلف بشكل ملحوظ (على سبيل المثال، في هولاندا، العدد هو من واحد إلى أربعين).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Yawancin sanannun Baltic Cruises sun ƙunshi karin tsawan zama a St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: غالب أغلبsafarin Baltic, yana da wani lokaci da ya kasance a St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Wannan na nuna cewa kana iya ziyartar birni mai tarihi na kwanaki da dama yayin da ake dawowa ko yin bacci a cikin jirgin ruwan da dare.
translations.hypothesis: wannan yana  Mean ana za a iya ziyar da birni na tarihi kawai ga wasu rana, kuma za a koma kuma yin tuni a bohari.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Idan ka hau ruwa ta amfani da yawon bude ido a jirgin ruwa ba za ka buƙaci biza ta daban ba (kamar daga 2009).
translations.hypothesis: إِنْ كَانَ سَعْدَك يقتصر على السفر إلى بر باستخدام رحلات المراكب، فَلن تحتاج إلى فيزا ضامن (حسب عام 2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Babban birnin Moldova shi ne Chişinău. yaren cikin gida shi ne Romaniyanci, amma ana amfani da harshen Rasha sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Farko na Moldova shine Chişinău. Dillali na wannan ƙasa shine Romanian, amma Russian ana amfani dashi sosai.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: Maldova jamhuriya ce mai kabilu da dama da ta yi fama da rikicin kabilanci.
translations.hypothesis: مولдова هي جمهورية عرقية، التي عانت من النزاع بين الأعراق.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikici ya haifar da kirkirar da kanta mai ikirarin Jamhuriyyar Transnistria a gabashin Moldova, wacce ke da gwamnatinta da kudin ta amma ba wata kungiyar mambobin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shi ba.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin 1994, wannan ياراسا يوصل إلى تأسيس "جمهورية ترانسنيستريا" (Transnistria)، wanda ta اعلن وجودها, تقع ؤن النمط ؤشمالي لـ مولдова، ودار فيها حكومة و عملة خاصه، لكن لا تاكوي كاع عضو لـ الأمم المتحدة.

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: An maido da harkar cinikayya tsakanin bangarori biyu na Maldova duk da rushewar tattaunawar siyasa.
translations.hypothesis: حكومي ياه, لا يزالون موجودين بين هَذين الباقين مِن مولдова, لاسيما وأن التفاوض السياسي لم ينجح.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Babban addini a Moldova shine Kiristocin aqidah.
translations.hypothesis: الديانة העיקרית بـ مولдова هي المسيحية العضوية.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: Izmir shi ne birni na uku mafi girma a Turkiyya da yawan jama’a kimanin miliyan 3.7, kuma tashar jiragen ruwa ta biyu mafi girma bayan ta Istanbul, kuma babbar cibiyar sufuri.
translations.hypothesis: إزمير هي سابع ولاية لارجة في توركيا، مع ساكنة شاي 3.7 مليون، ثاني مخرج لارجة بعد إسطنبول، ومركز نقل عظيم.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: A da yana a matsayin tsohon birnin Smyrna, yanzu cibiyar hada-hadar kasuwanci ce ta zamani, da ta bnƙasa, da ta ke zagayen wani ƙaton mashigin ruwa sannan kuma yana zagaye da duwatsu.
translations.hypothesis: "A wani lokaci, wannan birni na 'Smyrna' yana, amma yanzu yana birni na zamani, da kuma kasuwa, wanda ke da wani lake mai girma kuma ana sa ta da garuruwa.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Manya-manyan tituna, gidajen gilashi da manyan kantunan siyayya an kawata su da jajayen rufi na gargajiya, kasuwa ta karni na 18, da wani tsohon masallaci da coci, koda yake dai garin ya fi kama da irin na turai da ke gabar bahar rum fiye da ace garin gargajiya ne a kasar Turkiya.
translations.hypothesis: الشارع الضخم، دار-دار masu fasalin ƙwar, da mashuwa na kasuwa na zamani, sun kasance da manyan ƙoƙo na launin launin kasa, sabuwar kasuwa, da masakan da kirke, duk da haka, wannan birni yana da madaidaicin ƙirar, kamar ƙasar Mediterranean, kuma ba kamar ƙasar Turkey ta al'ada.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Kauyen Haldarsvík yana ba da damar kallon tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa kuma yana da wata cocin mai kusurwa takwas wadda ba saba ganin irin ta ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙauyen Haldarsvík yana ɗaukar ɓangar da ya ɗau da ƙasa ta Eysturoy, kuma yana da ɗakin adama mai ɗan ƙasa.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Hakanan zuwa arewa ziyarci babban Wuri Mai Tsarki na Uwargidanmu Fatima (Shrine), wuri ne na shahararrun bayyanar Marian a duniya.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، نتوجه إلى وشمال، حيث ستزورون "Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima" (Shrine)، وهي مَكان مشهور عالميًا، حيث تظهر رؤيا "Marian".

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Da fatan za a tuna cewa da gaske ana ziyartar babban kabari ne, kazalika da shafin da ke da kusan ma'ana ga yawancin ɓangarorin duniya.
translations.hypothesis: راجاء تذكّر أن, هادي هي ببساطة زيارة لموقع قبر جماعي, شاي أيضًا موقع ذو دلالة ضخمة لنسبة كبيرة من مالي ؤ العالم.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: Har yanzu akwai maza da mata da yawa da ke raye waɗanda suka rayu lokacinsu a nan, kuma da yawa da yawa waɗanda suke da ƙaunatattunsu waɗanda aka kashe ko suka yi aiki zuwa can, yahudawa da waɗanda ba Yahudawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: حتى الآن، لا يزال هناك العديد من مزارين ونساء, اللذين نجوا, و المزيد من ذين, ذو أحباء, اللذين قُتلوا أو قُتلوا, سواء كانوا يهود أم لا.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.reference: Da fatan za a kula da rukunin yanar gizon tare da dukkan mutunci, girmamawa da girmama shi. Kada ku yi ba'a game da fitinar Holocaust ko Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: الرجاء، تعاملوا مع wannan حرجًا، مع احترام، وتقدير كاملاً. لا تضحكوا على موضوع الهولوكوست أو النازيين.

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Kada ku lalata wurin ginin ta hanyar sa alamar ko kuma nuna alamar rubutu a cikin ginin.
translations.hypothesis: لا تلطخ الموقع بوضع أو الكتابة على المباني.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Ko da yake, ana nuna galibin alamomin ana nuna su Katalanci sakamakon bisa doka shi ne yaren hukumana farko.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، أغلب الإشارات ناغار فقط بلهجة كاتالونيا، لكي لاحتمال أنها لغة رسمية أولى، وفقًا للقانون.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Duk da haka, ana kuma amfani da harshen Spanish sosai a harkar sufuri na jama’a da wasu wurare.
translations.hypothesis: لكن، الإسبانية زًا تُستخدم على نطاق واسع في نقل عام وأماكن عامة.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: Ana yin sanarwar yau da gobe a jirgin ƙarƙashin ƙasa a Catalan kaɗai, amma na’urar da ke aiki da kanta ce ke sanar da hargitsin da babu shiri a harsuna iri-iri da suka haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Turanci, Faransanci, Larabci da harshen Japan.
translations.hypothesis: إعلانات دورية بمدينة "الـ Metro" تُعطى حصريًا باللغة الكاتالونية، لكن اضطرابات غير متوقعة تُعطى إعلانات من نظام آلي، وفي مجموعة متنوعة من اللغات، بما في ذلك الإسبانية، الإنجليزية، الفرنسية، العربية، و اليابانية.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Mutanen Paris sun yi suna kan son kai, rashin kunya da girman kai.
translations.hypothesis: الناس بفرنسا سار, و يشتهرون بالغرور, و السلوك غير اللائق.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Yayin da yake wannan yawanci ra’ayi ne wanda ba daidai ba, hanya mafi kyau don yin sabo a cikin Paris har yanzu shine kasancewa kan halayyarka mafi kyau, yin aiki kamar wanda yake “bien élevé” (wanda ya sami tarbiyya mai kyau). Zai sanya yin sabo ya kasance mai sauki.
translations.hypothesis: بينما هاده غالبًا يُمثل تصوير غير صحيح، يفضل الطريقة الأفضل لكي تكون ناجحًا بمدينة باريس هي أن تكون حسن السلوك، وكأنك شخص "مُربي" (الذي نُربي بشكل جيد). wannan za ta يسهل عليك التنقل بشكل كبيْر.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Fuskar mutanen Paris ta bazata za ta yi saurin ɓacewa idan ka nuna wasu halayen girmamawa.
translations.hypothesis: إذا سلكت طريق الاحترام، فإن أيون الأجانب سيزول بسرعة.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Tafkunan Plitvice na wajen shakatawa yana da wani surkukin daji, galibi da kamannin bishiyoyin fir da na kudan zuma da kuma hadin wanda ya shafi manyan tsaunuka da duwatsu tare da ciyaye na Rum.
translations.hypothesis: پارك القاءات Plitvice هو حديقة طبيعية, تملأها غابات, בעיקר شجر Beech, Spruce, و Fir, و تشتمل على مزيج من نباتات جبال الألب و نباتات حوض البحر الأبيض المتوسط.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Tana da sanannun dangogin itatuwa iri daban-daban, sabo da jerin yankunan yanayi da ta ke da su, da bayyana nau’ukan ƙasa daban-daban da kuma tuddai masu mataki daban-daban.
translations.hypothesis: ذو تنوع ضخم جدًا في ساكن شجر, بسبب اختلاف مناخات, نوعي التربة, وارتفاعات.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Rukunin muhalli na ga dabbobin daji mabambanta da kuma launukan tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: المنطقة هي أيضًا موطن لعدد كبير جدًا من الأنواع المختلفة من الحيوانات وطيور.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Dabbobin daji da ba su da yawa irin su Malu mai launin ruwan kasa da ke turai, kerkeci, mikiya, mujiya, kyanwar daji da kuma capercaillie a na iya samun su a can, tare da nau’ukan gama garin dabbobi masu yawa.
translations.hypothesis: حيوانات نادرة, kamar حمار البر, الذئب, البوم, النسر, اللينكس, القط البري, و كابيركالي, هان, بالإضافة إلى العديد من الأنواع الأقل شيوع.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Yayin ziyartar gidajen sufaye, an buƙaci mata su sa riguna masu rufe gwiwowinsu kuma su rufe ƙafadunsu, kuma.
translations.hypothesis: Сана, ƴatata sun ziyarta, ana bukatar su yi amfani da ƙara da ke ɗaukar ƙasa, kuma ana bukatar su yi amfani da ƙara da ke ɗaukar fuska.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.

translations.hypothesis: 同ರೀ, ana bukaci masu nam, su yi amfani da ƙara da ke cire kisa.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Wannan ma za a iya aro shi daga tarin kayan a mashigar amma ba a wanke tufa bayan kowane mutum guda ya yi amfani da tufar don haka ba za ka/ki ji dadin saka wannan bujen ba. Kala guda zai iyamma dukkanin maza.

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: Babban abincin, kamar na yankuna masu kama da wannan a cikin Bahar Rum, ya dogara ne akan burodi, kayan lambu da nama (musamman alade), kuma yana amfani da man zaitun ko'ina.
translations.hypothesis: غذاவுَل манوريا، kamar wanda ana samu a wuraren kamar wannan a cikin Mediterranean, ana ɗaukar shi ne daga bukada, sabun da kunun (ba wai kunun bishiya), kuma ana amfani da zaitun duk lokacin.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Abincin dare mai sauki musamman ma lokacin bazara, shi ne na Pa amb Oli: Burodi ne da man zaitun da tumatir da kuma duk wani kayan hadin da ya samu kamar cukwui da abincin kifi da dai sauransu.
translations.hypothesis: وجبة ساهي ؤو، وخاصة خلال ؤهار, هي "Pa amb Oli": خبز ؤو مع زيت الزيتون، طماطم، و أي مواد تارت, kamar جبن، سمك تون، وغير ذلك.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Dukkan sunaye, wadanda ke da kalmar Sie a ciki, koda yaushe suna farawa ne da babban harafi, koda a tsakiyar jimla ne.
translations.hypothesis: كُلّ الأسماء، شاوكي الكلمة "Sie" لـ "أنت"، دايماً يابدون حرف عظيم، حتى وسط جملة.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Wannan mahimmiyar hanya ce wajen banbance kalmomin aikatau da kalmomi na abubuwa da ake iya gani.
translations.hypothesis: wannan shine няя ба yanayi don bayyana rawa da ƙirar.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Hakanan yana iya kawo sauƙin karatu, kodayake rubutu yana da ɗan rikitarwa ta hanyar buƙatar gano ko ana amfani da fi'ili ko sifa a cikin sigar tabbatarwa.
translations.hypothesis: ضال, يساغ يسهّل قراءة, لاء, يالكتابة لاء تاي زو, فيه النّقاش, أيا أن نرى إذا كان الفعل أو الصفة لاء مستخدمة في شكل اسم.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Furuci yana da ɗan sauƙi a cikin Italiyanci tunda yawancin kalmomi ana furta daidai yadda ake rubuta suu
translations.hypothesis: اللفاظ (التهجئة) نسبيًا سهلة في الإيطالية، لعمومًا، الكلمات تُلفظ بالطريقة التي تُكتب.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Manyan haruffan da ya kamata a lura da su a nan sune c da g, kasancewar furucinsu ya banbamta daga wannan wasalin da ke biye.
translations.hypothesis: الأحرف الأساسية اللاتي يجب الانتباه إليها هما "c" و "g"، لأن طريقة النطق שלהم تختلف بناءً على الحرف المتحرك التالي.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Hakanan, tabbatar da furta r da rr daban: caro yana nufin ƙaunata, yayin da karas yana nufin karusa.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك, يرجى التأكد من نطق "r" و "rr" بأساليب ضابطة: "caro" لـ "عزيز", بينما "carro" لـ "عربة".

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: Farisa tana da nahawu mai sauki da na yau da kullum.
translations.hypothesis: Persian yana da ƙirar da ta kasance da sauƙi kuma ta kasance da ƙirar da ta kasance da sababta.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Saboda haka, karanta wannan share fagen nahawun zai taimaka muku koya da yawa game da nahawun Farisanci da fahimtar jumla da kyau.
translations.hypothesis: بنا على ذلك, قراءة wannan "مقدمة" عى القواعد ستساعدك على تعلم شىء كثيرة عن القواعد عى لغة الفارسية, و فهم العبارات بشكل صحيح.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: A bayyane take, idan ka san yaren Romance, zai yi sauki maka ka koyi Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: Ba za a iya ɓashin ba, idan kun san wani labarin, za a iya sauke Portuguese da sauƙi.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Duk da haka, mutanen da ba su iya yaren sifaniyanci sosai ba ke ganin yaren Portuguese ya yi kusa da shi yadda ba lallai a karance shi daban ba.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Yawanci hasumiyoyin nazarin samaniya na baya sun zama tsohon yayi yanzu, inda suka zama gidajen kayan tarihi, ko kuma wuraren koyon ilimi.
translations.hypothesis: الأبراج النجمية القديمة، عادةً ما لاء، و هما الآن متاحف، أو أماكن لتعليم.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda gurbacewar haske a lokacin ganiyasa ba kamar irin yadda matsalar take a halin yanzu ba, galibi ya fi yawa a birane da kuma harabobin makarantun jami’a, wanda ya fi saukin samuwa akan wadanda aka gina a birane.
translations.hypothesis: بينما تلوث الضوء, وقت ذي أهمية, لم يمثل مشكلة كما هو الحال اليوم, هؤلاء عادةً يجدون في سياق أو في جامعات, و هง่าย لزيارة مقارنة مع تلك التي بُنيت في أزمنة معاصرة.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Yawancin gilasan hangen nesa na bincike na zamani kayayyaki ne masu girma sosai a yankunan da ke da tsarin yanayi masu kyau.
translations.hypothesis: غالب أغلب تلسكوب البحث ؤر الحديث هما داري ضخمة ؤ cikin ƙasa, da shawa na yanayi.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Kallon buɗewar furen cherry, wanda aka sani da hanami, ya kasance wani ɓangare na al'adun Japan tun ƙarni na 8.
translations.hypothesis: "Zurfi da kwayen cherry, wanda ana ke kira da "hanami", yana da muhim a sana'a da rayuwa na Japan tun daga shekarar 800.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Tunanin ya fito ne daga China inda plum da suka yi girma sun kasance fure ne wanda aka fi so.
translations.hypothesis: الفكرة جاءت مِْن الصين، حَيْثُ زهرة البلوط هِيَ الزهرة المفضلَة.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: A Japan, sarkin ne ya shirya kungiyar siyasa na farko don kan sa kawai da wasu membobin da ke da martaba kewaye da kotun sarakuna..
translations.hypothesis: غالبًا, أول احتفالات زهرة الكرز نا'im yana yi a Japan, كان مخصصة لاحداfit, و باقي الأعضاء البارزين, و هؤلاء كانوا يحيطون بالملكة.

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Tsirrai sun fi kyau idan suna muhallinsu na halitta, saboda haka guji zumuɗin tsige ko da samfur “daya ne kawai”.
translations.hypothesis: النباتો يظهرون بأفضل شكل عندما هما cikin סور طبيعي، لכן, يمنعوا غريزة إزالة "حتى شګه".

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Idan kana ziyartar shiryayen lambu, tattara “samfurori” shi ma zai iya jawo wa a fitar da kai, ba tare da tattaunawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ако زائر сада, "جمع" عينات, يال, يال يوصل إلى طرد, دون أي تفاوض.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: Garin Singapore gari ne da akasari ya ke da tsaro ingantacce kuma da saukin ganewa, kuma ka na iya siyen komai daga saukarka a kasar.
translations.hypothesis: Singapur عامًا هو مكوّن دقيق وأسهل في التنقل، وبعد الفتح، زوارสามารถ لشراء أي شيء.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Amma ana sanya ku a cikin “manyan yankuna masu tsaka-tsakin” kawai ƴan digiri kaɗan arewacin kerjin za ku buƙaci ma'amala da zafin rana (koyaushe) da rana mai ƙarfi (lokacin da sama ta bayyana, mafi wuya).
translations.hypothesis: لكن، كونك موجود في "المنطقة الاستوائية الدافئة"، تقع بضعة درجات شمالي خط الاستواء، ستحتاج إلى التعامل مع الحرارة (دائمًا) وضوء شمس قوي (عندما السماء صافية، ولكنه نادر).

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Ka tabbatar motar da zaka shiga lalle wadda za ta je Hebron ce ba wadanda ke zuwa sabbin unguwanni yahudawa da ke Kiryat Arba ba ne.
translations.hypothesis: تأكد أن حافيتو كوك, كوك أن تذهاب, تذهاب إلى Hebron, لا مجرد إلى سكن يهودي القريب, Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Jirgin ruwa na cikin gida na iya zama jigo mai kyau don kafa hutu a kusa.
translations.hypothesis: الأنهار الداخلية (Inland waterways) ناءة، و هى خيار زحفى لبرمجة عطلة.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: A misali ziyartar fadoji a Loire Valley, kwarin Rhine ko hawan jirgin ruwa zuwa wurare masu ban sha’awa a Danube ko tafiya cikin kwalekwale ta Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: عن سبيل، زيارة القلاع في وادي لوير، وادي راين، أو ركوب رحلة بحرية إلى ولايات متميزة على نهر دانوب، أو ركوب قارب على قناة إيري.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Hakanan suna ayyana hanyoyi don shahararrun tattaki da hanyoyin keke.
translations.hypothesis: هذان يحددون أيضًا مسارات لـ "طرق المشي" و "طرق ركوب الدراجة" المفضل.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: Kirsimeti wani biki ne mai mahimmanci na Kiristanci, kuma ana bikinta a matsayin ranar haihuwar Yesu.
translations.hypothesis: عيد الميلاد هو ملامة muhim ta addini, kuma ana me sha a matsayin ranar dogon Yesu.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Da yawan an al’adun da ke zgaye da bikin sun sami karɓuwa har daga waɗanda ba su yi imani ba a kasashen kristoci da waɗanda bana kristoci ba a fadin duniya.
translations.hypothesis: كثير من التقاليد اللاتي ساروا حول العيد, هما زُرت أيضًا من قِبَل أولئك اللاتي لا يتباعون المسيحية, في دول المسيحية, و أيضًا من قِبَل غير المسيحيين, في شتى أجزاء العالم.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Akwai wata al'ada ta kwanan zaune a daren Easter a wani wuri buɗaɗɗe don ganin fitowar rana.
translations.hypothesis: اللإيجاء, تاما, تاما, ana yi aikin zama cikin wani wuri wanda ya kasance wajen, domin ɓangaren rana.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Tabbas da akwai bayanai daga koyarwar addinin Kirista kan wannan al’adar, amma dai yana iya kasancewa Shekaru ne gabanin bayyanar Kiristanci.
translations.hypothesis: بایان, تايو يوقي تفسيرات ديني, amma يوقي يوقي يوقي, يوقي يوقي

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Duk dabbobin da suka isa tsibirin asalin sun zo nan ne ta hanyar iyo, tashi ko iyo.
translations.hypothesis: دুমام, ساروها, اللاتي أولين يغلبن إلى جزر, هان هنا, إما عن طريق السباحة, الطيران, أو الغرق.

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: Saboda doguwar nesa daga nahiyoyi masu shayarwa ba su iya yin tafiyar ba wanda ya sa katowar kunkuru matsayin dabba ta farko da ake kiwo a Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: بسبب المسافة الطويلة من القارة، حيوات لا تستطيع السفر، ولهذا، السلحفاة الكبيرة هي الحيوان الأهم الذي يأكل الأعشاب في جالفاروس.

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Tun zuwan mutum ga Galapagos, an gabatar da dabbobi masu shayarwa da yawa da suka hada da awaki, dawakai, shanu, beraye, kuliyoyi da karnuka.
translations.hypothesis: منذ أن மனுس يحل إلى جزر غالاباغوس، يوسعوه شاة، خيول، غنم، دغا, قط, و كلاب.

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Idan ka ziyarci nahiyar Arctic ko Antarctica a lokacin hunturu zaka tsinkayi daren sanyi, wanda a lokacinsa rana bata fitowa.
translations.hypothesis: Ако زائرون округу القطب الشمالي أو القطب الجنوبي, cikin mako, za su fuskantar "الليل القطب", wannan yana nuna cewa rana ba za ta fara zagayawa ba.

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Wannan yana ba da kyakkyawar dama don ganin Aurora borealis, tunda sama zata kasance mai duhu sosai ko ƙasa da agogo.
translations.hypothesis: wannan yana ba babban damar ڒا يَر Aurora borealis, domin sama za iya zama cikin ڍا, ڒا ڒا.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Tunda yankunan ba su da cinkoson jama’a, kuma babu matsalar gurɓacewar haske, za kuma ka ji daɗin taurarin.
translations.hypothesis: لأن الأماكن لا يغلب عليها, و بالتالي تلوث الضوء لست مشكلة, زاي, زاي زاي.

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Al’adun aiki na Japanese na da matsayi fiye da abin da kasashen yamma suka saba.
translations.hypothesis: المنهجية الأجنبية (اليابانية) تختلف, و هى تفرض تسلسل هرمي و رسمي, و يختلف عن الأساليب التي قد يكون الغربيون مألوفين معها.

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Kwat sune kayan sawa na aiki da aka saba dasu kuma abokan aiki suna kiran juna ne da sunan gidan su ko kuma matsayin da mutum yake kai.
translations.hypothesis: الألبسة هما طাউاري عادية, و زملائهم سمانا سارا أو سمانا سارا باحرف وظائف.

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Zaman lafiya a wurin aiki abu ne me muhimmanci, ana bada mahimmanci wurin hadaka tare sama da jinjina yin aiki kai daya.
translations.hypothesis: سالمة وشغور مهمة, وتأكيد على تعاون جماعي, بدلاً من التقدير لإنجازات فردية.

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Dole ne ma’aikata su sami amincewar manyan su akan duk wata shawara da suka zartas, kuma ana tsammanin su yi biyayya ga umarnin manyan su ba tare da tambaya ba.
translations.hypothesis: 'الأفراد ناයකوا ليلزموا الحصول على إذن من رؤسائهم لأي قرار, و يُتوقع منهم أن يطيعوا تعليمات رؤسائهم دون أي اعتراض.
